				country_event = { id = COLDWAR_OPEC.2 }
		} }
	}
	COLDWAR_OPEC_s3_free = yes
}

# Any scope. Weekly: the offer of file 3 waits for its target (a player's deadline only runs in weeks he plays).
COLDWAR_OPEC_s3_offer_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { var:global.cwop_s3_target = { exists = yes } } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s3_offer_declined = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:global.cwop_s3_target = { COLDWAR_OPEC_seen_player = yes } }
		if = {
			limit = { var:global.cwop_s3_target = { is_ai = yes } }
			add_to_variable = { global.cwop_s3_due = 7 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwop_s3_due } } }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_s3_offer_declined = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwop_s3_due } } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s3_ctx = yes
		var:global.cwop_s3_target = { COLDWAR_OPEC_offer_stance = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { var:global.cwop_s3_target = { check_variable = { cwop_ai = 1 } } }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_s3_offer_accepted = yes
		}
		else = {
			COLDWAR_OPEC_s3_offer_declined = yes
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Counts the votes on file 3 (players and AI delegations); adopted files move on, the others close.
COLDWAR_OPEC_s3_close = {
	COLDWAR_OPEC_s3_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_OPEC_ctx_props = yes
	COLDWAR_OPEC_tally = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s3_res = cwop_t_res }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s3_share = cwop_t_fshare }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s3_nf = cwop_t_nf }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s3_na = cwop_t_na }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s3_nr = cwop_t_nr }
	clear_array = global.cwop_s3_part
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = cwop_t_bound
		add_to_array = { global.cwop_s3_part = THIS }
	}
	clear_array = global.cwop_s3_against
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = cwop_t_blockers
		add_to_array = { global.cwop_s3_against = THIS }
	}
	COLDWAR_OPEC_s3_ctx = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_res = cwop_t_res }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_res > 0 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_record_add = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_res = 1 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s3_passed = yes
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_res = 2 } }
			# a veto: world news naming the first member that voted Against
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nw = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s3_against^num > 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nw = global.cwop_s3_against^0 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = global.cwop_ctx_share }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = 100 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_item = global.cwop_ctx_item }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_res = 10 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_target = global.cwop_ctx_target }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_by = global.cwop_ctx_by }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_who = cwop_t_nw }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_a = global.cwop_ctx_nf }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_b = global.cwop_ctx_nr }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_c = global.cwop_ctx_na }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_d = cwop_t_nd }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_news = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_res = 4 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = global.cwop_ctx_share }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = 100 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_item = global.cwop_ctx_item }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_res = 11 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_target = global.cwop_ctx_target }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_by = global.cwop_ctx_by }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_who = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_a = global.cwop_ctx_nf }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_b = global.cwop_ctx_nr }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_c = global.cwop_ctx_na }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_d = cwop_t_nd }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_news = yes
		}
		else = {
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwop_members
				if = { limit = { exists = yes is_ai = no }
					set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eitem = global.cwop_ctx_item }
					add_to_array = { cwop_q2_item = cwop_t_eitem }
					set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eres = global.cwop_ctx_res }
					add_to_array = { cwop_q2_res = cwop_t_eres }
					set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_etarget = global.cwop_ctx_target }
					add_to_array = { cwop_q2_target = cwop_t_etarget }
					set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eval = 0 }
					add_to_array = { cwop_q2_val = cwop_t_eval }
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev2_busy } }
						set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev2_busy days = 30 value = 1 }
						country_event = { id = COLDWAR_OPEC.2 }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		COLDWAR_OPEC_ctx_lock = yes
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s3_free = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. Next step of file 3 after an adopted vote (notice period, offer, or in force at once).
COLDWAR_OPEC_s3_passed = {
	COLDWAR_OPEC_s3_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_OPEC_ctx_props = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s3_target > 0 }
			NOT = { var:global.cwop_s3_target = { exists = yes } } }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_res = 8 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwop_members
			if = { limit = { exists = yes is_ai = no }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eitem = global.cwop_ctx_item }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q2_item = cwop_t_eitem }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eres = global.cwop_ctx_res }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q2_res = cwop_t_eres }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_etarget = global.cwop_ctx_target }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q2_target = cwop_t_etarget }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eval = 0 }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q2_val = cwop_t_eval }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev2_busy } }
					set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev2_busy days = 30 value = 1 }
					country_event = { id = COLDWAR_OPEC.2 }
				}
			}
		}
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s3_free = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_OPEC_ctx_no_place = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = global.cwop_ctx_share }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = 100 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_item = global.cwop_ctx_item }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_res = 15 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_target = global.cwop_ctx_target }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_by = global.cwop_ctx_by }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_who = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_a = global.cwop_ctx_nf }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_b = global.cwop_ctx_nr }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_c = global.cwop_ctx_na }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_d = cwop_t_nd }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_news = yes
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s3_free = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { # a country that asked to observe (D7) has already said yes: in force at once
			check_variable = { global.cwop_s3_item = 47 }
			check_variable = { global.cwop_s3_by = global.cwop_s3_target } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = global.cwop_ctx_share }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = 100 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_item = global.cwop_ctx_item }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_res = 2 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_target = global.cwop_ctx_target }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_by = global.cwop_ctx_by }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_who = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_a = global.cwop_ctx_nf }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_b = global.cwop_ctx_nr }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_c = global.cwop_ctx_na }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_d = cwop_t_nd }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_news = yes
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_quiet = 1 }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s3_apply = yes
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_quiet = 0 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { # offers after a vote: the USA (D5), observers (D7), co-operation (D9), Fund programmes (F1)
			OR = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s3_item = 45 } check_variable = { global.cwop_s3_item = 47 } check_variable = { global.cwop_s3_item = 49 } check_variable = { global.cwop_s3_item = 50 } } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = global.cwop_ctx_share }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = 100 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_item = global.cwop_ctx_item }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_res = 3 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_target = global.cwop_ctx_target }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_by = global.cwop_ctx_by }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_who = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_a = global.cwop_ctx_nf }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_b = global.cwop_ctx_nr }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_c = global.cwop_ctx_na }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_d = cwop_t_nd }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_news = yes
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s3_start_offer = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_imm = 1 }
			OR = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s3_route = 1 } check_variable = { cwop_t_thr = 4 } } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s3_route = 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = global.cwop_ctx_share }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = 100 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_item = global.cwop_ctx_item }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_res = 5 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_target = global.cwop_ctx_target }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_by = global.cwop_ctx_by }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_who = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_a = global.cwop_ctx_nf }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_b = global.cwop_ctx_nr }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_c = global.cwop_ctx_na }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_d = cwop_t_nd }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_news = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = global.cwop_ctx_share }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = 100 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_item = global.cwop_ctx_item }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_res = 2 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_target = global.cwop_ctx_target }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_by = global.cwop_ctx_by }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_who = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_a = global.cwop_ctx_nf }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_b = global.cwop_ctx_nr }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_c = global.cwop_ctx_na }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_d = cwop_t_nd }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_news = yes
		}
		# the world news replaces the members' notice of entry into force
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_quiet = 1 }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s3_apply = yes
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_quiet = 0 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_imm = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = global.cwop_ctx_share }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = 100 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_item = global.cwop_ctx_item }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_res = 2 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_target = global.cwop_ctx_target }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_by = global.cwop_ctx_by }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_who = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_a = global.cwop_ctx_nf }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_b = global.cwop_ctx_nr }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_c = global.cwop_ctx_na }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_d = cwop_t_nd }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_news = yes
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_quiet = 1 }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s3_apply_watch = yes
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_quiet = 0 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { global.cwop_s3_phase = 5 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_days = 30 }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s3_phase_for = yes
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = global.cwop_ctx_share }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = 100 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_item = global.cwop_ctx_item }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_res = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_target = global.cwop_ctx_target }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_by = global.cwop_ctx_by }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_who = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_a = global.cwop_ctx_nf }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_b = global.cwop_ctx_nr }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_c = global.cwop_ctx_na }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_d = cwop_t_nd }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_news = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. File 3 enters into force for the members bound by it, then closes.
COLDWAR_OPEC_s3_apply = {
	COLDWAR_OPEC_s3_ctx = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s3_target > 0 }
			NOT = { var:global.cwop_s3_target = { exists = yes } } }
		# the target no longer exists: nothing enters into force
		set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_res = 8 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwop_members
			if = { limit = { exists = yes is_ai = no }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eitem = global.cwop_ctx_item }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q2_item = cwop_t_eitem }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eres = global.cwop_ctx_res }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q2_res = cwop_t_eres }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_etarget = global.cwop_ctx_target }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q2_target = cwop_t_etarget }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eval = 0 }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q2_val = cwop_t_eval }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev2_busy } }
					set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev2_busy days = 30 value = 1 }
					country_event = { id = COLDWAR_OPEC.2 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_OPEC_ctx_no_place = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = global.cwop_ctx_share }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = 100 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_item = global.cwop_ctx_item }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_res = 15 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_target = global.cwop_ctx_target }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_by = global.cwop_ctx_by }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_who = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_a = global.cwop_ctx_nf }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_b = global.cwop_ctx_nr }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_c = global.cwop_ctx_na }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_d = cwop_t_nd }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_news = yes
	}
	else = {
		COLDWAR_OPEC_ctx_apply = yes
		set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_res = 9 }
		# an admission has its own notice (event 6); with a world news in the same step no notice
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwop_t_quiet = 1 } }
				NOT = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s3_item = 41 } } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwop_members
				if = { limit = { exists = yes is_ai = no }
					set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eitem = global.cwop_ctx_item }
					add_to_array = { cwop_q5_item = cwop_t_eitem }
					set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eres = global.cwop_ctx_res }
					add_to_array = { cwop_q5_res = cwop_t_eres }
					set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_etarget = global.cwop_ctx_target }
					add_to_array = { cwop_q5_target = cwop_t_etarget }
					set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eval = 0 }
					add_to_array = { cwop_q5_val = cwop_t_eval }
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev5_busy } }
						set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev5_busy days = 30 value = 1 }
						country_event = { id = COLDWAR_OPEC.5 }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	COLDWAR_OPEC_s3_free = yes
	COLDWAR_OPEC_refresh_all = yes
}

# Any scope. File 3 is in force at once; for 30 days a bound member may still object and leave the obligation (Art. 11).
COLDWAR_OPEC_s3_apply_watch = {
	COLDWAR_OPEC_s3_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_OPEC_ctx_apply = yes
	COLDWAR_OPEC_refresh_all = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s3_phase = 8 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_days = 30 }
	COLDWAR_OPEC_s3_phase_for = yes
}

# Country scope (a full member). Objects to file 3 within its 30 days (Statute Art. 11).
COLDWAR_OPEC_s3_object = {
	COLDWAR_OPEC_s3_ctx = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s3_phase = 5 } }
		# Art. 11: a resolution does not take effect when a full member objects within 30 days
		set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_res = 5 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nw = THIS.id }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = global.cwop_ctx_share }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = 100 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_item = global.cwop_ctx_item }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_res = 13 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_target = global.cwop_ctx_target }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_by = global.cwop_ctx_by }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_who = cwop_t_nw }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_a = global.cwop_ctx_nf }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_b = global.cwop_ctx_nr }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_c = global.cwop_ctx_na }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_d = cwop_t_nd }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_news = yes
		COLDWAR_OPEC_ctx_lock = yes
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s3_free = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s3_phase = 8 } }
		# the resolution is already in force: the objector leaves its obligation
		remove_from_array = { global.cwop_s3_part = THIS }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_ctx_unbind = yes
		COLDWAR_OPEC_refresh_country = yes
	}
	add_to_variable = { global.cwop_dirty = 1 }
}

# Any scope. Weekly during the 30 days of file 3: an AI delegation that was turned against it (Against) objects.
COLDWAR_OPEC_s3_ai_objections = {
	COLDWAR_OPEC_s3_ctx = yes
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_fell = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwop_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes is_ai = yes is_in_array = { array = global.cwop_s3_part value = THIS } check_variable = { cwop_t_fell = 0 } }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_stance = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ai = 2 } }
				COLDWAR_OPEC_s3_object = yes
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_fell = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Weekly deadlines of file 3.
COLDWAR_OPEC_s3_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s3_phase = 6 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s3_offer_tick = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s3_phase = 1 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwop_s3_due } } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s3_to_queue = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s3_phase = 3 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwop_s3_due } } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s3_close_extra = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s3_phase = 7 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwop_s3_due } } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s3_close = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s3_phase = 5 } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwop_s3_due } } }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_s3_apply = yes
		}
		else = {
			COLDWAR_OPEC_s3_ai_objections = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s3_phase = 8 } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwop_s3_due } } }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_s3_free = yes
		}
		else = {
			COLDWAR_OPEC_s3_ai_objections = yes
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The approval for an extraordinary Conference on file 3 closes: approved, the Conference sits 21 days; otherwise the file waits for the next ordinary one.
COLDWAR_OPEC_s3_close_extra = {
	COLDWAR_OPEC_s3_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_OPEC_tally_approval = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_ok = 1 }
			NOT = { COLDWAR_OPEC_in_session = yes } }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_sess = 2 }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_sess_slot = 3 }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_sess_end = global.num_days }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwop_sess_end = 21 }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwop_sess_no = 1 }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_rotate_president = yes
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s3_open_vote = yes
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s3_ctx = yes
		set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_res = 0 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwop_members
			if = { limit = { exists = yes is_ai = no }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eitem = global.cwop_ctx_item }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q1_item = cwop_t_eitem }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eres = global.cwop_ctx_res }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q1_res = cwop_t_eres }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_etarget = global.cwop_ctx_target }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q1_target = cwop_t_etarget }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eval = 1 }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q1_val = cwop_t_eval }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev1_busy } }
					set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev1_busy days = 30 value = 1 }
					country_event = { id = COLDWAR_OPEC.1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_ok = 1 } }
		# approved while a Conference sits: the file joins its agenda
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s3_open_vote = yes
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s3_ctx = yes
		set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_res = 0 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwop_members
			if = { limit = { exists = yes is_ai = no }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eitem = global.cwop_ctx_item }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q2_item = cwop_t_eitem }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eres = global.cwop_ctx_res }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q2_res = cwop_t_eres }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_etarget = global.cwop_ctx_target }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q2_target = cwop_t_etarget }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eval = 0 }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q2_val = cwop_t_eval }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev2_busy } }
					set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev2_busy days = 30 value = 1 }
					country_event = { id = COLDWAR_OPEC.2 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s3_to_queue = yes
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s3_ctx = yes
		set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_res = 4 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwop_members
			if = { limit = { exists = yes is_ai = no }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eitem = global.cwop_ctx_item }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q2_item = cwop_t_eitem }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eres = global.cwop_ctx_res }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q2_res = cwop_t_eres }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_etarget = global.cwop_ctx_target }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q2_target = cwop_t_etarget }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eval = 2 }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q2_val = cwop_t_eval }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev2_busy } }
					set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev2_busy days = 30 value = 1 }
					country_event = { id = COLDWAR_OPEC.2 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Copies file 4 into the read-only context used by the item effects, KI-Lite and the texts.
COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_ctx = {
	set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_slot = 4 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = global.cwop_s4_item }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_phase = global.cwop_s4_phase }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_due = global.cwop_s4_due }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_since = global.cwop_s4_since }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_len = global.cwop_s4_len }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_issue = global.cwop_s4_issue }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_target = global.cwop_s4_target }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_opt1 = global.cwop_s4_opt1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_opt2 = global.cwop_s4_opt2 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_by = global.cwop_s4_by }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_ticket = global.cwop_s4_ticket }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_route = global.cwop_s4_route }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_res = global.cwop_s4_res }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_share = global.cwop_s4_share }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_nf = global.cwop_s4_nf }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_na = global.cwop_s4_na }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_nr = global.cwop_s4_nr }
	clear_array = global.cwop_ctx_part
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwop_s4_part
		add_to_array = { global.cwop_ctx_part = THIS }
	}
}

# Any scope. Closes file 4.
COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_free = {
	COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_OPEC_ctx_unbusy = yes
	# an admission file that closes gives the candidate its former status back (other files on a candidate leave it alone)
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s4_target > 0 }
			OR = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s4_item = 41 } check_variable = { global.cwop_s4_item = 42 } } }
		var:global.cwop_s4_target = { if = { limit = { COLDWAR_OPEC_is_candidate = yes } set_variable = { cwop_status = cwop_st_prev } COLDWAR_OPEC_set_status_idea = yes } }
	}
	clear_array = global.cwop_s4_part
	clear_array = global.cwop_s4_against
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_sess = 2 }
			check_variable = { global.cwop_sess_slot = 4 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_sess_slot = 0 }
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s4_item = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s4_phase = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s4_due = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s4_since = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s4_len = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s4_issue = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s4_target = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s4_opt1 = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s4_opt2 = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s4_by = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s4_ticket = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s4_route = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s4_res = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s4_share = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s4_nf = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s4_na = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s4_nr = 0 }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwop_dirty = 1 }
}

# Any scope. temp cwop_t_days: deadline of the current phase of file 4.
COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_phase_for = {
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s4_since = global.num_days }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s4_due = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwop_s4_due = cwop_t_days }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s4_len = cwop_t_days }
}

# Any scope. A new vote or offer on file 4: new issue number (old votes no longer count), persuasion reset.
COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_new_issue = {
	add_to_variable = { global.cwop_issue = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s4_issue = global.cwop_issue }
	# persuasion of the delegations starts afresh for this file
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwop_watch
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			set_variable = { cwop_pl4 = 0 }
			clear_array = cwop_lob4
			clear_array = cwop_pay4
			clear_array = cwop_prs4
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. A new vote on file 4: new issue number (old votes no longer count); the persuasion of the delegations stays with the file.
COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_next_issue = {
	add_to_variable = { global.cwop_issue = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s4_issue = global.cwop_issue }
}

# Any scope. File 4 waits for the next Conference.
COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_to_queue = {
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s4_phase = 2 }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwop_ticket = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s4_ticket = global.cwop_ticket }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s4_since = global.num_days }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s4_len = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s4_due = 0 }
}

# Any scope. File 4 goes to the Secretariat for the draft (the Secretary General may table it at once or decline it).
COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_to_draft = {
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s4_phase = 1 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_days = 30 }
	COLDWAR_OPEC_workload = yes
	multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_days = cwop_t_load }
	round_temp_variable = cwop_t_days
	COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_phase_for = yes
}

# Country scope (requesting player). Opens file 4 with the temp request (cwop_t_item, target, opt1, opt2, route, invite).
COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_open = {
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s4_item = cwop_t_item }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s4_target = cwop_t_target }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s4_opt1 = cwop_t_opt1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s4_opt2 = cwop_t_opt2 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s4_route = cwop_t_route }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s4_by = THIS.id }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s4_res = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s4_share = 0 }
	COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_OPEC_ctx_busy = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s4_target > 0 } }
		var:global.cwop_s4_target = { COLDWAR_OPEC_watch = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { # the Arab oil ministers meet at once
			check_variable = { cwop_t_route = 1 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_s4_phase = 7 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_days = 14 }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_phase_for = yes
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_new_issue = yes
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_ctx = yes
		set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_res = 0 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwop_oapec
			if = { limit = { exists = yes is_ai = no }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eitem = global.cwop_ctx_item }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q1_item = cwop_t_eitem }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eres = global.cwop_ctx_res }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q1_res = cwop_t_eres }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_etarget = global.cwop_ctx_target }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q1_target = cwop_t_etarget }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eval = 3 }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q1_val = cwop_t_eval }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev1_busy } }
					set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev1_busy days = 30 value = 1 }
					country_event = { id = COLDWAR_OPEC.1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { # an invitation: the invited country answers first
			check_variable = { cwop_t_invite = 1 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_start_offer = yes
	}
	else = {
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_new_issue = yes
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_to_draft = yes
	}
	add_to_variable = { global.cwop_dirty = 1 }
}

# Any scope. File 4 goes before the sitting Conference.
COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_open_vote = {
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s4_phase = 4 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s4_due = global.cwop_sess_end }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s4_since = global.num_days }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s4_len = global.cwop_sess_end }
	subtract_from_variable = { global.cwop_s4_len = global.num_days }
	COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_next_issue = yes
}

# Any scope. A member asks for an extraordinary Conference on file 4; the members approve by simple majority in 7 days.
COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_ask_extra = {
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s4_phase = 3 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_days = 7 }
	COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_phase_for = yes
	COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_next_issue = yes
	COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_ctx = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_res = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwop_members
		if = { limit = { exists = yes is_ai = no }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eitem = global.cwop_ctx_item }
			add_to_array = { cwop_q1_item = cwop_t_eitem }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eres = global.cwop_ctx_res }
			add_to_array = { cwop_q1_res = cwop_t_eres }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_etarget = global.cwop_ctx_target }
			add_to_array = { cwop_q1_target = cwop_t_etarget }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eval = 2 }
			add_to_array = { cwop_q1_val = cwop_t_eval }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev1_busy } }
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev1_busy days = 30 value = 1 }
				country_event = { id = COLDWAR_OPEC.1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. File 4: the target receives the invitation or the offer (a player answers in the window within 60 days of play; an AI country decides by KI-Lite after 30 days in which players may lobby it).
COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_start_offer = {
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s4_phase = 6 }
	COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_new_issue = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s4_ticket = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:global.cwop_s4_target = { COLDWAR_OPEC_seen_player = yes } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_days = 60 }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_phase_for = yes
		set_variable = { global.cwop_s4_ticket = 0 }
		var:global.cwop_s4_target = { set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eitem = global.cwop_s4_item }
			add_to_array = { cwop_q3_item = cwop_t_eitem }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eres = 0 }
			add_to_array = { cwop_q3_res = cwop_t_eres }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_etarget = global.cwop_s4_by }
			add_to_array = { cwop_q3_target = cwop_t_etarget }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eval = 0 }
			add_to_array = { cwop_q3_val = cwop_t_eval }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev3_busy } }
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev3_busy days = 30 value = 1 }
				country_event = { id = COLDWAR_OPEC.3 }
		} }
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_days = 30 }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_phase_for = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. The target of file 4 accepts: an invitation becomes a candidacy (draft and opinion of the Secretary General), an offer after a vote takes effect.
COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_offer_accepted = {
	COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_ctx = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s4_res = 0 }
			OR = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s4_item = 41 } check_variable = { global.cwop_s4_item = 42 } } }
		var:global.cwop_s4_target = { if = { limit = { NOT = { COLDWAR_OPEC_is_candidate = yes } } set_variable = { cwop_st_prev = cwop_status } } set_variable = { cwop_status = 2 } COLDWAR_OPEC_set_status_idea = yes }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_new_issue = yes
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_to_draft = yes
	}
	else = {
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_apply = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. The target of file 4 declines (or does not answer in time).
COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_offer_declined = {
	COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_ctx = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_res = 6 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:global.cwop_s4_by = { exists = yes is_ai = no } }
		var:global.cwop_s4_by = { set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eitem = global.cwop_ctx_item }
			add_to_array = { cwop_q2_item = cwop_t_eitem }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eres = 6 }
			add_to_array = { cwop_q2_res = cwop_t_eres }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_etarget = global.cwop_ctx_target }
			add_to_array = { cwop_q2_target = cwop_t_etarget }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eval = 0 }
			add_to_array = { cwop_q2_val = cwop_t_eval }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev2_busy } }
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev2_busy days = 30 value = 1 }
				country_event = { id = COLDWAR_OPEC.2 }
		} }
	}
	COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_free = yes
}

# Any scope. Weekly: the offer of file 4 waits for its target (a player's deadline only runs in weeks he plays).
COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_offer_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { var:global.cwop_s4_target = { exists = yes } } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_offer_declined = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:global.cwop_s4_target = { COLDWAR_OPEC_seen_player = yes } }
		if = {
			limit = { var:global.cwop_s4_target = { is_ai = yes } }
			add_to_variable = { global.cwop_s4_due = 7 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwop_s4_due } } }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_offer_declined = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwop_s4_due } } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_ctx = yes
		var:global.cwop_s4_target = { COLDWAR_OPEC_offer_stance = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { var:global.cwop_s4_target = { check_variable = { cwop_ai = 1 } } }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_offer_accepted = yes
		}
		else = {
			COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_offer_declined = yes
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Counts the votes on file 4 (players and AI delegations); adopted files move on, the others close.
COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_close = {
	COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_OPEC_ctx_props = yes
	COLDWAR_OPEC_tally = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s4_res = cwop_t_res }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s4_share = cwop_t_fshare }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s4_nf = cwop_t_nf }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s4_na = cwop_t_na }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s4_nr = cwop_t_nr }
	clear_array = global.cwop_s4_part
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = cwop_t_bound
		add_to_array = { global.cwop_s4_part = THIS }
	}
	clear_array = global.cwop_s4_against
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = cwop_t_blockers
		add_to_array = { global.cwop_s4_against = THIS }
	}
	COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_ctx = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_res = cwop_t_res }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_res > 0 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_record_add = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_res = 1 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_passed = yes
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_res = 2 } }
			# a veto: world news naming the first member that voted Against
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nw = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s4_against^num > 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nw = global.cwop_s4_against^0 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = global.cwop_ctx_share }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = 100 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_item = global.cwop_ctx_item }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_res = 10 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_target = global.cwop_ctx_target }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_by = global.cwop_ctx_by }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_who = cwop_t_nw }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_a = global.cwop_ctx_nf }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_b = global.cwop_ctx_nr }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_c = global.cwop_ctx_na }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_d = cwop_t_nd }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_news = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_res = 4 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = global.cwop_ctx_share }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = 100 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_item = global.cwop_ctx_item }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_res = 11 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_target = global.cwop_ctx_target }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_by = global.cwop_ctx_by }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_who = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_a = global.cwop_ctx_nf }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_b = global.cwop_ctx_nr }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_c = global.cwop_ctx_na }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_d = cwop_t_nd }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_news = yes
		}
		else = {
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwop_members
				if = { limit = { exists = yes is_ai = no }
					set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eitem = global.cwop_ctx_item }
					add_to_array = { cwop_q2_item = cwop_t_eitem }
					set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eres = global.cwop_ctx_res }
					add_to_array = { cwop_q2_res = cwop_t_eres }
					set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_etarget = global.cwop_ctx_target }
					add_to_array = { cwop_q2_target = cwop_t_etarget }
					set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eval = 0 }
					add_to_array = { cwop_q2_val = cwop_t_eval }
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev2_busy } }
						set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev2_busy days = 30 value = 1 }
						country_event = { id = COLDWAR_OPEC.2 }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		COLDWAR_OPEC_ctx_lock = yes
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_free = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. Next step of file 4 after an adopted vote (notice period, offer, or in force at once).
COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_passed = {
	COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_OPEC_ctx_props = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s4_target > 0 }
			NOT = { var:global.cwop_s4_target = { exists = yes } } }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_res = 8 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwop_members
			if = { limit = { exists = yes is_ai = no }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eitem = global.cwop_ctx_item }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q2_item = cwop_t_eitem }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eres = global.cwop_ctx_res }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q2_res = cwop_t_eres }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_etarget = global.cwop_ctx_target }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q2_target = cwop_t_etarget }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eval = 0 }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q2_val = cwop_t_eval }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev2_busy } }
					set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev2_busy days = 30 value = 1 }
					country_event = { id = COLDWAR_OPEC.2 }
				}
			}
		}
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_free = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_OPEC_ctx_no_place = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = global.cwop_ctx_share }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = 100 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_item = global.cwop_ctx_item }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_res = 15 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_target = global.cwop_ctx_target }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_by = global.cwop_ctx_by }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_who = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_a = global.cwop_ctx_nf }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_b = global.cwop_ctx_nr }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_c = global.cwop_ctx_na }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_d = cwop_t_nd }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_news = yes
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_free = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { # a country that asked to observe (D7) has already said yes: in force at once
			check_variable = { global.cwop_s4_item = 47 }
			check_variable = { global.cwop_s4_by = global.cwop_s4_target } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = global.cwop_ctx_share }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = 100 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_item = global.cwop_ctx_item }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_res = 2 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_target = global.cwop_ctx_target }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_by = global.cwop_ctx_by }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_who = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_a = global.cwop_ctx_nf }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_b = global.cwop_ctx_nr }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_c = global.cwop_ctx_na }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_d = cwop_t_nd }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_news = yes
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_quiet = 1 }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_apply = yes
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_quiet = 0 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { # offers after a vote: the USA (D5), observers (D7), co-operation (D9), Fund programmes (F1)
			OR = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s4_item = 45 } check_variable = { global.cwop_s4_item = 47 } check_variable = { global.cwop_s4_item = 49 } check_variable = { global.cwop_s4_item = 50 } } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = global.cwop_ctx_share }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = 100 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_item = global.cwop_ctx_item }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_res = 3 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_target = global.cwop_ctx_target }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_by = global.cwop_ctx_by }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_who = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_a = global.cwop_ctx_nf }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_b = global.cwop_ctx_nr }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_c = global.cwop_ctx_na }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_d = cwop_t_nd }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_news = yes
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_start_offer = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_imm = 1 }
			OR = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s4_route = 1 } check_variable = { cwop_t_thr = 4 } } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s4_route = 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = global.cwop_ctx_share }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = 100 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_item = global.cwop_ctx_item }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_res = 5 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_target = global.cwop_ctx_target }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_by = global.cwop_ctx_by }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_who = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_a = global.cwop_ctx_nf }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_b = global.cwop_ctx_nr }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_c = global.cwop_ctx_na }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_d = cwop_t_nd }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_news = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = global.cwop_ctx_share }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = 100 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_item = global.cwop_ctx_item }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_res = 2 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_target = global.cwop_ctx_target }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_by = global.cwop_ctx_by }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_who = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_a = global.cwop_ctx_nf }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_b = global.cwop_ctx_nr }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_c = global.cwop_ctx_na }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_d = cwop_t_nd }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_news = yes
		}
		# the world news replaces the members' notice of entry into force
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_quiet = 1 }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_apply = yes
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_quiet = 0 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_imm = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = global.cwop_ctx_share }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = 100 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_item = global.cwop_ctx_item }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_res = 2 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_target = global.cwop_ctx_target }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_by = global.cwop_ctx_by }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_who = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_a = global.cwop_ctx_nf }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_b = global.cwop_ctx_nr }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_c = global.cwop_ctx_na }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_d = cwop_t_nd }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_news = yes
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_quiet = 1 }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_apply_watch = yes
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_quiet = 0 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { global.cwop_s4_phase = 5 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_days = 30 }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_phase_for = yes
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = global.cwop_ctx_share }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = 100 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_item = global.cwop_ctx_item }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_res = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_target = global.cwop_ctx_target }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_by = global.cwop_ctx_by }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_who = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_a = global.cwop_ctx_nf }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_b = global.cwop_ctx_nr }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_c = global.cwop_ctx_na }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_d = cwop_t_nd }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_news = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. File 4 enters into force for the members bound by it, then closes.
COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_apply = {
	COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_ctx = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s4_target > 0 }
			NOT = { var:global.cwop_s4_target = { exists = yes } } }
		# the target no longer exists: nothing enters into force
		set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_res = 8 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwop_members
			if = { limit = { exists = yes is_ai = no }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eitem = global.cwop_ctx_item }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q2_item = cwop_t_eitem }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eres = global.cwop_ctx_res }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q2_res = cwop_t_eres }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_etarget = global.cwop_ctx_target }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q2_target = cwop_t_etarget }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eval = 0 }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q2_val = cwop_t_eval }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev2_busy } }
					set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev2_busy days = 30 value = 1 }
					country_event = { id = COLDWAR_OPEC.2 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_OPEC_ctx_no_place = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = global.cwop_ctx_share }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = 100 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_item = global.cwop_ctx_item }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_res = 15 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_target = global.cwop_ctx_target }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_by = global.cwop_ctx_by }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_who = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_a = global.cwop_ctx_nf }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_b = global.cwop_ctx_nr }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_c = global.cwop_ctx_na }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_d = cwop_t_nd }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_news = yes
	}
	else = {
		COLDWAR_OPEC_ctx_apply = yes
		set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_res = 9 }
		# an admission has its own notice (event 6); with a world news in the same step no notice
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwop_t_quiet = 1 } }
				NOT = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s4_item = 41 } } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwop_members
				if = { limit = { exists = yes is_ai = no }
					set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eitem = global.cwop_ctx_item }
					add_to_array = { cwop_q5_item = cwop_t_eitem }
					set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eres = global.cwop_ctx_res }
					add_to_array = { cwop_q5_res = cwop_t_eres }
					set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_etarget = global.cwop_ctx_target }
					add_to_array = { cwop_q5_target = cwop_t_etarget }
					set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eval = 0 }
					add_to_array = { cwop_q5_val = cwop_t_eval }
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev5_busy } }
						set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev5_busy days = 30 value = 1 }
						country_event = { id = COLDWAR_OPEC.5 }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_free = yes
	COLDWAR_OPEC_refresh_all = yes
}

# Any scope. File 4 is in force at once; for 30 days a bound member may still object and leave the obligation (Art. 11).
COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_apply_watch = {
	COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_OPEC_ctx_apply = yes
	COLDWAR_OPEC_refresh_all = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s4_phase = 8 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_days = 30 }
	COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_phase_for = yes
}

# Country scope (a full member). Objects to file 4 within its 30 days (Statute Art. 11).
COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_object = {
	COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_ctx = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s4_phase = 5 } }
		# Art. 11: a resolution does not take effect when a full member objects within 30 days
		set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_res = 5 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nw = THIS.id }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = global.cwop_ctx_share }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = 100 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_item = global.cwop_ctx_item }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_res = 13 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_target = global.cwop_ctx_target }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_by = global.cwop_ctx_by }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_who = cwop_t_nw }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_a = global.cwop_ctx_nf }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_b = global.cwop_ctx_nr }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_c = global.cwop_ctx_na }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_d = cwop_t_nd }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_news = yes
		COLDWAR_OPEC_ctx_lock = yes
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_free = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s4_phase = 8 } }
		# the resolution is already in force: the objector leaves its obligation
		remove_from_array = { global.cwop_s4_part = THIS }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_ctx_unbind = yes
		COLDWAR_OPEC_refresh_country = yes
	}
	add_to_variable = { global.cwop_dirty = 1 }
}

# Any scope. Weekly during the 30 days of file 4: an AI delegation that was turned against it (Against) objects.
COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_ai_objections = {
	COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_ctx = yes
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_fell = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwop_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes is_ai = yes is_in_array = { array = global.cwop_s4_part value = THIS } check_variable = { cwop_t_fell = 0 } }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_stance = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ai = 2 } }
				COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_object = yes
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_fell = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Weekly deadlines of file 4.
COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s4_phase = 6 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_offer_tick = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s4_phase = 1 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwop_s4_due } } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_to_queue = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s4_phase = 3 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwop_s4_due } } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_close_extra = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s4_phase = 7 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwop_s4_due } } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_close = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s4_phase = 5 } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwop_s4_due } } }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_apply = yes
		}
		else = {
			COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_ai_objections = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s4_phase = 8 } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwop_s4_due } } }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_free = yes
		}
		else = {
			COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_ai_objections = yes
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The approval for an extraordinary Conference on file 4 closes: approved, the Conference sits 21 days; otherwise the file waits for the next ordinary one.
COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_close_extra = {
	COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_OPEC_tally_approval = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_ok = 1 }
			NOT = { COLDWAR_OPEC_in_session = yes } }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_sess = 2 }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_sess_slot = 4 }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_sess_end = global.num_days }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwop_sess_end = 21 }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwop_sess_no = 1 }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_rotate_president = yes
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_open_vote = yes
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_ctx = yes
		set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_res = 0 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwop_members
			if = { limit = { exists = yes is_ai = no }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eitem = global.cwop_ctx_item }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q1_item = cwop_t_eitem }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eres = global.cwop_ctx_res }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q1_res = cwop_t_eres }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_etarget = global.cwop_ctx_target }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q1_target = cwop_t_etarget }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eval = 1 }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q1_val = cwop_t_eval }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev1_busy } }
					set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev1_busy days = 30 value = 1 }
					country_event = { id = COLDWAR_OPEC.1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_ok = 1 } }
		# approved while a Conference sits: the file joins its agenda
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_open_vote = yes
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_ctx = yes
		set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_res = 0 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwop_members
			if = { limit = { exists = yes is_ai = no }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eitem = global.cwop_ctx_item }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q2_item = cwop_t_eitem }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eres = global.cwop_ctx_res }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q2_res = cwop_t_eres }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_etarget = global.cwop_ctx_target }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q2_target = cwop_t_etarget }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eval = 0 }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q2_val = cwop_t_eval }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev2_busy } }
					set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev2_busy days = 30 value = 1 }
					country_event = { id = COLDWAR_OPEC.2 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_to_queue = yes
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_ctx = yes
		set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_res = 4 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwop_members
			if = { limit = { exists = yes is_ai = no }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eitem = global.cwop_ctx_item }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q2_item = cwop_t_eitem }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eres = global.cwop_ctx_res }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q2_res = cwop_t_eres }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_etarget = global.cwop_ctx_target }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q2_target = cwop_t_etarget }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eval = 2 }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q2_val = cwop_t_eval }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev2_busy } }
					set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev2_busy days = 30 value = 1 }
					country_event = { id = COLDWAR_OPEC.2 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Copies file 5 into the read-only context used by the item effects, KI-Lite and the texts.
COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_ctx = {
	set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_slot = 5 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = global.cwop_s5_item }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_phase = global.cwop_s5_phase }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_due = global.cwop_s5_due }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_since = global.cwop_s5_since }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_len = global.cwop_s5_len }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_issue = global.cwop_s5_issue }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_target = global.cwop_s5_target }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_opt1 = global.cwop_s5_opt1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_opt2 = global.cwop_s5_opt2 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_by = global.cwop_s5_by }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_ticket = global.cwop_s5_ticket }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_route = global.cwop_s5_route }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_res = global.cwop_s5_res }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_share = global.cwop_s5_share }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_nf = global.cwop_s5_nf }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_na = global.cwop_s5_na }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_nr = global.cwop_s5_nr }
	clear_array = global.cwop_ctx_part
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwop_s5_part
		add_to_array = { global.cwop_ctx_part = THIS }
	}
}

# Any scope. Closes file 5.
COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_free = {
	COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_OPEC_ctx_unbusy = yes
	# an admission file that closes gives the candidate its former status back (other files on a candidate leave it alone)
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s5_target > 0 }
			OR = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s5_item = 41 } check_variable = { global.cwop_s5_item = 42 } } }
		var:global.cwop_s5_target = { if = { limit = { COLDWAR_OPEC_is_candidate = yes } set_variable = { cwop_status = cwop_st_prev } COLDWAR_OPEC_set_status_idea = yes } }
	}
	clear_array = global.cwop_s5_part
	clear_array = global.cwop_s5_against
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_sess = 2 }
			check_variable = { global.cwop_sess_slot = 5 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_sess_slot = 0 }
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s5_item = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s5_phase = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s5_due = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s5_since = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s5_len = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s5_issue = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s5_target = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s5_opt1 = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s5_opt2 = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s5_by = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s5_ticket = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s5_route = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s5_res = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s5_share = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s5_nf = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s5_na = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s5_nr = 0 }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwop_dirty = 1 }
}

# Any scope. temp cwop_t_days: deadline of the current phase of file 5.
COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_phase_for = {
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s5_since = global.num_days }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s5_due = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwop_s5_due = cwop_t_days }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s5_len = cwop_t_days }
}

# Any scope. A new vote or offer on file 5: new issue number (old votes no longer count), persuasion reset.
COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_new_issue = {
	add_to_variable = { global.cwop_issue = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s5_issue = global.cwop_issue }
	# persuasion of the delegations starts afresh for this file
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwop_watch
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			set_variable = { cwop_pl5 = 0 }
			clear_array = cwop_lob5
			clear_array = cwop_pay5
			clear_array = cwop_prs5
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. A new vote on file 5: new issue number (old votes no longer count); the persuasion of the delegations stays with the file.
COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_next_issue = {
	add_to_variable = { global.cwop_issue = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s5_issue = global.cwop_issue }
}

# Any scope. File 5 waits for the next Conference.
COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_to_queue = {
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s5_phase = 2 }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwop_ticket = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s5_ticket = global.cwop_ticket }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s5_since = global.num_days }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s5_len = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s5_due = 0 }
}

# Any scope. File 5 goes to the Secretariat for the draft (the Secretary General may table it at once or decline it).
COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_to_draft = {
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s5_phase = 1 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_days = 30 }
	COLDWAR_OPEC_workload = yes
	multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_days = cwop_t_load }
	round_temp_variable = cwop_t_days
	COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_phase_for = yes
}

# Country scope (requesting player). Opens file 5 with the temp request (cwop_t_item, target, opt1, opt2, route, invite).
COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_open = {
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s5_item = cwop_t_item }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s5_target = cwop_t_target }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s5_opt1 = cwop_t_opt1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s5_opt2 = cwop_t_opt2 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s5_route = cwop_t_route }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s5_by = THIS.id }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s5_res = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s5_share = 0 }
	COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_OPEC_ctx_busy = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s5_target > 0 } }
		var:global.cwop_s5_target = { COLDWAR_OPEC_watch = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { # the Arab oil ministers meet at once
			check_variable = { cwop_t_route = 1 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_s5_phase = 7 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_days = 14 }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_phase_for = yes
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_new_issue = yes
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_ctx = yes
		set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_res = 0 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwop_oapec
			if = { limit = { exists = yes is_ai = no }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eitem = global.cwop_ctx_item }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q1_item = cwop_t_eitem }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eres = global.cwop_ctx_res }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q1_res = cwop_t_eres }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_etarget = global.cwop_ctx_target }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q1_target = cwop_t_etarget }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eval = 3 }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q1_val = cwop_t_eval }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev1_busy } }
					set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev1_busy days = 30 value = 1 }
					country_event = { id = COLDWAR_OPEC.1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { # an invitation: the invited country answers first
			check_variable = { cwop_t_invite = 1 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_start_offer = yes
	}
	else = {
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_new_issue = yes
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_to_draft = yes
	}
	add_to_variable = { global.cwop_dirty = 1 }
}

# Any scope. File 5 goes before the sitting Conference.
COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_open_vote = {
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s5_phase = 4 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s5_due = global.cwop_sess_end }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s5_since = global.num_days }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s5_len = global.cwop_sess_end }
	subtract_from_variable = { global.cwop_s5_len = global.num_days }
	COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_next_issue = yes
}

# Any scope. A member asks for an extraordinary Conference on file 5; the members approve by simple majority in 7 days.
COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_ask_extra = {
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s5_phase = 3 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_days = 7 }
	COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_phase_for = yes
	COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_next_issue = yes
	COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_ctx = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_res = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwop_members
		if = { limit = { exists = yes is_ai = no }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eitem = global.cwop_ctx_item }
			add_to_array = { cwop_q1_item = cwop_t_eitem }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eres = global.cwop_ctx_res }
			add_to_array = { cwop_q1_res = cwop_t_eres }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_etarget = global.cwop_ctx_target }
			add_to_array = { cwop_q1_target = cwop_t_etarget }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eval = 2 }
			add_to_array = { cwop_q1_val = cwop_t_eval }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev1_busy } }
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev1_busy days = 30 value = 1 }
				country_event = { id = COLDWAR_OPEC.1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. File 5: the target receives the invitation or the offer (a player answers in the window within 60 days of play; an AI country decides by KI-Lite after 30 days in which players may lobby it).
COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_start_offer = {
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s5_phase = 6 }
	COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_new_issue = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s5_ticket = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:global.cwop_s5_target = { COLDWAR_OPEC_seen_player = yes } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_days = 60 }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_phase_for = yes
		set_variable = { global.cwop_s5_ticket = 0 }
		var:global.cwop_s5_target = { set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eitem = global.cwop_s5_item }
			add_to_array = { cwop_q3_item = cwop_t_eitem }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eres = 0 }
			add_to_array = { cwop_q3_res = cwop_t_eres }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_etarget = global.cwop_s5_by }
			add_to_array = { cwop_q3_target = cwop_t_etarget }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eval = 0 }
			add_to_array = { cwop_q3_val = cwop_t_eval }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev3_busy } }
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev3_busy days = 30 value = 1 }
				country_event = { id = COLDWAR_OPEC.3 }
		} }
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_days = 30 }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_phase_for = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. The target of file 5 accepts: an invitation becomes a candidacy (draft and opinion of the Secretary General), an offer after a vote takes effect.
COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_offer_accepted = {
	COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_ctx = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s5_res = 0 }
			OR = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s5_item = 41 } check_variable = { global.cwop_s5_item = 42 } } }
		var:global.cwop_s5_target = { if = { limit = { NOT = { COLDWAR_OPEC_is_candidate = yes } } set_variable = { cwop_st_prev = cwop_status } } set_variable = { cwop_status = 2 } COLDWAR_OPEC_set_status_idea = yes }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_new_issue = yes
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_to_draft = yes
	}
	else = {
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_apply = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. The target of file 5 declines (or does not answer in time).
COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_offer_declined = {
	COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_ctx = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_res = 6 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:global.cwop_s5_by = { exists = yes is_ai = no } }
		var:global.cwop_s5_by = { set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eitem = global.cwop_ctx_item }
			add_to_array = { cwop_q2_item = cwop_t_eitem }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eres = 6 }
			add_to_array = { cwop_q2_res = cwop_t_eres }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_etarget = global.cwop_ctx_target }
			add_to_array = { cwop_q2_target = cwop_t_etarget }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eval = 0 }
			add_to_array = { cwop_q2_val = cwop_t_eval }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev2_busy } }
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev2_busy days = 30 value = 1 }
				country_event = { id = COLDWAR_OPEC.2 }
		} }
	}
	COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_free = yes
}

# Any scope. Weekly: the offer of file 5 waits for its target (a player's deadline only runs in weeks he plays).
COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_offer_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { var:global.cwop_s5_target = { exists = yes } } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_offer_declined = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:global.cwop_s5_target = { COLDWAR_OPEC_seen_player = yes } }
		if = {
			limit = { var:global.cwop_s5_target = { is_ai = yes } }
			add_to_variable = { global.cwop_s5_due = 7 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwop_s5_due } } }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_offer_declined = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwop_s5_due } } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_ctx = yes
		var:global.cwop_s5_target = { COLDWAR_OPEC_offer_stance = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { var:global.cwop_s5_target = { check_variable = { cwop_ai = 1 } } }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_offer_accepted = yes
		}
		else = {
			COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_offer_declined = yes
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Counts the votes on file 5 (players and AI delegations); adopted files move on, the others close.
COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_close = {
	COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_OPEC_ctx_props = yes
	COLDWAR_OPEC_tally = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s5_res = cwop_t_res }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s5_share = cwop_t_fshare }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s5_nf = cwop_t_nf }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s5_na = cwop_t_na }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_s5_nr = cwop_t_nr }
	clear_array = global.cwop_s5_part
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = cwop_t_bound
		add_to_array = { global.cwop_s5_part = THIS }
	}
	clear_array = global.cwop_s5_against
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = cwop_t_blockers
		add_to_array = { global.cwop_s5_against = THIS }
	}
	COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_ctx = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_res = cwop_t_res }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_res > 0 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_record_add = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_res = 1 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_passed = yes
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_res = 2 } }
			# a veto: world news naming the first member that voted Against
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nw = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s5_against^num > 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nw = global.cwop_s5_against^0 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = global.cwop_ctx_share }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = 100 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_item = global.cwop_ctx_item }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_res = 10 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_target = global.cwop_ctx_target }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_by = global.cwop_ctx_by }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_who = cwop_t_nw }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_a = global.cwop_ctx_nf }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_b = global.cwop_ctx_nr }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_c = global.cwop_ctx_na }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_d = cwop_t_nd }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_news = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_res = 4 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = global.cwop_ctx_share }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = 100 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_item = global.cwop_ctx_item }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_res = 11 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_target = global.cwop_ctx_target }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_by = global.cwop_ctx_by }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_who = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_a = global.cwop_ctx_nf }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_b = global.cwop_ctx_nr }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_c = global.cwop_ctx_na }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_d = cwop_t_nd }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_news = yes
		}
		else = {
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwop_members
				if = { limit = { exists = yes is_ai = no }
					set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eitem = global.cwop_ctx_item }
					add_to_array = { cwop_q2_item = cwop_t_eitem }
					set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eres = global.cwop_ctx_res }
					add_to_array = { cwop_q2_res = cwop_t_eres }
					set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_etarget = global.cwop_ctx_target }
					add_to_array = { cwop_q2_target = cwop_t_etarget }
					set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eval = 0 }
					add_to_array = { cwop_q2_val = cwop_t_eval }
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev2_busy } }
						set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev2_busy days = 30 value = 1 }
						country_event = { id = COLDWAR_OPEC.2 }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		COLDWAR_OPEC_ctx_lock = yes
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_free = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. Next step of file 5 after an adopted vote (notice period, offer, or in force at once).
COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_passed = {
	COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_OPEC_ctx_props = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s5_target > 0 }
			NOT = { var:global.cwop_s5_target = { exists = yes } } }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_res = 8 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwop_members
			if = { limit = { exists = yes is_ai = no }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eitem = global.cwop_ctx_item }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q2_item = cwop_t_eitem }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eres = global.cwop_ctx_res }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q2_res = cwop_t_eres }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_etarget = global.cwop_ctx_target }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q2_target = cwop_t_etarget }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eval = 0 }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q2_val = cwop_t_eval }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev2_busy } }
					set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev2_busy days = 30 value = 1 }
					country_event = { id = COLDWAR_OPEC.2 }
				}
			}
		}
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_free = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_OPEC_ctx_no_place = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = global.cwop_ctx_share }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = 100 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_item = global.cwop_ctx_item }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_res = 15 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_target = global.cwop_ctx_target }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_by = global.cwop_ctx_by }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_who = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_a = global.cwop_ctx_nf }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_b = global.cwop_ctx_nr }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_c = global.cwop_ctx_na }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_d = cwop_t_nd }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_news = yes
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_free = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { # a country that asked to observe (D7) has already said yes: in force at once
			check_variable = { global.cwop_s5_item = 47 }
			check_variable = { global.cwop_s5_by = global.cwop_s5_target } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = global.cwop_ctx_share }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = 100 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_item = global.cwop_ctx_item }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_res = 2 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_target = global.cwop_ctx_target }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_by = global.cwop_ctx_by }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_who = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_a = global.cwop_ctx_nf }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_b = global.cwop_ctx_nr }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_c = global.cwop_ctx_na }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_d = cwop_t_nd }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_news = yes
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_quiet = 1 }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_apply = yes
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_quiet = 0 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { # offers after a vote: the USA (D5), observers (D7), co-operation (D9), Fund programmes (F1)
			OR = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s5_item = 45 } check_variable = { global.cwop_s5_item = 47 } check_variable = { global.cwop_s5_item = 49 } check_variable = { global.cwop_s5_item = 50 } } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = global.cwop_ctx_share }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = 100 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_item = global.cwop_ctx_item }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_res = 3 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_target = global.cwop_ctx_target }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_by = global.cwop_ctx_by }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_who = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_a = global.cwop_ctx_nf }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_b = global.cwop_ctx_nr }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_c = global.cwop_ctx_na }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_d = cwop_t_nd }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_news = yes
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_start_offer = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_imm = 1 }
			OR = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s5_route = 1 } check_variable = { cwop_t_thr = 4 } } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s5_route = 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = global.cwop_ctx_share }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = 100 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_item = global.cwop_ctx_item }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_res = 5 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_target = global.cwop_ctx_target }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_by = global.cwop_ctx_by }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_who = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_a = global.cwop_ctx_nf }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_b = global.cwop_ctx_nr }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_c = global.cwop_ctx_na }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_d = cwop_t_nd }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_news = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = global.cwop_ctx_share }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = 100 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_item = global.cwop_ctx_item }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_res = 2 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_target = global.cwop_ctx_target }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_by = global.cwop_ctx_by }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_who = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_a = global.cwop_ctx_nf }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_b = global.cwop_ctx_nr }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_c = global.cwop_ctx_na }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_d = cwop_t_nd }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_news = yes
		}
		# the world news replaces the members' notice of entry into force
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_quiet = 1 }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_apply = yes
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_quiet = 0 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_imm = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = global.cwop_ctx_share }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = 100 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_item = global.cwop_ctx_item }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_res = 2 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_target = global.cwop_ctx_target }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_by = global.cwop_ctx_by }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_who = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_a = global.cwop_ctx_nf }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_b = global.cwop_ctx_nr }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_c = global.cwop_ctx_na }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_d = cwop_t_nd }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_news = yes
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_quiet = 1 }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_apply_watch = yes
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_quiet = 0 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { global.cwop_s5_phase = 5 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_days = 30 }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_phase_for = yes
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = global.cwop_ctx_share }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = 100 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_item = global.cwop_ctx_item }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_res = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_target = global.cwop_ctx_target }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_by = global.cwop_ctx_by }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_who = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_a = global.cwop_ctx_nf }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_b = global.cwop_ctx_nr }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_c = global.cwop_ctx_na }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_d = cwop_t_nd }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_news = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. File 5 enters into force for the members bound by it, then closes.
COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_apply = {
	COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_ctx = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s5_target > 0 }
			NOT = { var:global.cwop_s5_target = { exists = yes } } }
		# the target no longer exists: nothing enters into force
		set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_res = 8 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwop_members
			if = { limit = { exists = yes is_ai = no }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eitem = global.cwop_ctx_item }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q2_item = cwop_t_eitem }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eres = global.cwop_ctx_res }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q2_res = cwop_t_eres }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_etarget = global.cwop_ctx_target }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q2_target = cwop_t_etarget }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eval = 0 }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q2_val = cwop_t_eval }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev2_busy } }
					set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev2_busy days = 30 value = 1 }
					country_event = { id = COLDWAR_OPEC.2 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_OPEC_ctx_no_place = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = global.cwop_ctx_share }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nd = 100 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_item = global.cwop_ctx_item }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_res = 15 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_target = global.cwop_ctx_target }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_by = global.cwop_ctx_by }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_who = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_a = global.cwop_ctx_nf }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_b = global.cwop_ctx_nr }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_c = global.cwop_ctx_na }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n_d = cwop_t_nd }
