		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_bests = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s5_phase = 2 }
			check_variable = { global.cwop_s5_ticket < cwop_t_best } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_best = global.cwop_s5_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_bests = 5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s6_phase = 2 }
			check_variable = { global.cwop_s6_ticket < cwop_t_best } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_best = global.cwop_s6_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_bests = 6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s7_phase = 2 }
			check_variable = { global.cwop_s7_ticket < cwop_t_best } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_best = global.cwop_s7_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_bests = 7 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s8_phase = 2 }
			check_variable = { global.cwop_s8_ticket < cwop_t_best } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_best = global.cwop_s8_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_bests = 8 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_bests = 1 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s1_open_vote = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_bests = 2 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s2_open_vote = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_bests = 3 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s3_open_vote = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_bests = 4 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_open_vote = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_bests = 5 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_open_vote = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_bests = 6 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s6_open_vote = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_bests = 7 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s7_open_vote = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_bests = 8 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s8_open_vote = yes
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_res = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_target = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwop_members
		if = { limit = { exists = yes is_ai = no }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eitem = global.cwop_ctx_item }
			add_to_array = { cwop_q1_item = cwop_t_eitem }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eres = global.cwop_ctx_res }
			add_to_array = { cwop_q1_res = cwop_t_eres }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_etarget = global.cwop_ctx_target }
			add_to_array = { cwop_q1_target = cwop_t_etarget }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eval = 0 }
			add_to_array = { cwop_q1_val = cwop_t_eval }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev1_busy } }
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev1_busy days = 30 value = 1 }
				country_event = { id = COLDWAR_OPEC.1 }
			}
		}
	}
	COLDWAR_OPEC_next_session_day = yes
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_next = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_sess_next = cwop_t_next }
}

# Any scope. The Conference closes; every file before it is counted.
COLDWAR_OPEC_close_session = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s1_phase = 4 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s1_close = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s2_phase = 4 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s2_close = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s3_phase = 4 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s3_close = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s4_phase = 4 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_close = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s5_phase = 4 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_close = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s6_phase = 4 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s6_close = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s7_phase = 4 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s7_close = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s8_phase = 4 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s8_close = yes
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwop_sess = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_sess_slot = 0 }
}

# Any scope. Weekly: opens and closes the Conference.
COLDWAR_OPEC_session_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_OPEC_in_session = yes
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwop_sess_end } } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_close_session = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { COLDWAR_OPEC_in_session = yes }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwop_sess_next } } }
		if = {
			limit = { OR = {
					COLDWAR_OPEC_any_player_member = yes
					check_variable = { global.cwop_s1_phase = 2 }
					check_variable = { global.cwop_s2_phase = 2 }
					check_variable = { global.cwop_s3_phase = 2 }
					check_variable = { global.cwop_s4_phase = 2 }
					check_variable = { global.cwop_s5_phase = 2 }
					check_variable = { global.cwop_s6_phase = 2 }
					check_variable = { global.cwop_s7_phase = 2 }
					check_variable = { global.cwop_s8_phase = 2 }
			} }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_open_session = yes
		}
		else = {
			# no player delegation and no file waiting: the Conference date passes
			COLDWAR_OPEC_next_session_day = yes
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_next = 1 }
			set_variable = { global.cwop_sess_next = cwop_t_next }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. An extraordinary Conference closes as soon as every seated player has voted.
COLDWAR_OPEC_check_all_voted = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_OPEC_in_session = yes
			check_variable = { global.cwop_sess = 2 }
			all_of_scopes = {
				array = global.cwop_members
				OR = {
					is_ai = yes
					AND = { check_variable = { global.cwop_sess_slot = 1 } check_variable = { cwop_vi1 = global.cwop_s1_issue } }
					AND = { check_variable = { global.cwop_sess_slot = 2 } check_variable = { cwop_vi2 = global.cwop_s2_issue } }
					AND = { check_variable = { global.cwop_sess_slot = 3 } check_variable = { cwop_vi3 = global.cwop_s3_issue } }
					AND = { check_variable = { global.cwop_sess_slot = 4 } check_variable = { cwop_vi4 = global.cwop_s4_issue } }
					AND = { check_variable = { global.cwop_sess_slot = 5 } check_variable = { cwop_vi5 = global.cwop_s5_issue } }
					AND = { check_variable = { global.cwop_sess_slot = 6 } check_variable = { cwop_vi6 = global.cwop_s6_issue } }
					AND = { check_variable = { global.cwop_sess_slot = 7 } check_variable = { cwop_vi7 = global.cwop_s7_issue } }
					AND = { check_variable = { global.cwop_sess_slot = 8 } check_variable = { cwop_vi8 = global.cwop_s8_issue } }
				}
		} }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_close_session = yes
	}
}

# Country scope. temp cwop_t_gv: the vote of this delegation on the file in the context (1 For, 2 Against, 3 Reservation, 0 absent player); AI delegations by KI-Lite.
COLDWAR_OPEC_vote_of = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_ai = yes }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_stance = yes
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_gv = cwop_ai }
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_slot = 1 } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwop_vi1 = global.cwop_s1_issue } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_gv = cwop_v1 }
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_gv = 0 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_slot = 2 } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwop_vi2 = global.cwop_s2_issue } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_gv = cwop_v2 }
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_gv = 0 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_slot = 3 } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwop_vi3 = global.cwop_s3_issue } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_gv = cwop_v3 }
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_gv = 0 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_slot = 4 } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwop_vi4 = global.cwop_s4_issue } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_gv = cwop_v4 }
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_gv = 0 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_slot = 5 } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwop_vi5 = global.cwop_s5_issue } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_gv = cwop_v5 }
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_gv = 0 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_slot = 6 } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwop_vi6 = global.cwop_s6_issue } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_gv = cwop_v6 }
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_gv = 0 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_slot = 7 } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwop_vi7 = global.cwop_s7_issue } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_gv = cwop_v7 }
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_gv = 0 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_slot = 8 } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwop_vi8 = global.cwop_s8_issue } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_gv = cwop_v8 }
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_gv = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Counts the file in the context. temp cwop_t_res: 1 adopted, 2 blocked by an Against, 3 no effect (For-voters under 15 % of world exports), 4 no majority; temp arrays cwop_t_bound (For-voters and absent players) and cwop_t_blockers.
COLDWAR_OPEC_tally = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nf = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_na = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nr = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nabs = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_fshare = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nfound = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_ffound = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_res = 0 }
	clear_temp_array = cwop_t_bound
	clear_temp_array = cwop_t_blockers
	clear_array = global.cwop_ctx_voters
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_route = 1 } }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwop_oapec
			if = { limit = { exists = yes } add_to_array = { global.cwop_ctx_voters = THIS } }
		}
	}
	else = {
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwop_members
			if = { limit = { exists = yes } add_to_array = { global.cwop_ctx_voters = THIS } }
		}
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwop_ctx_voters
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n = 1 }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_vote_of = yes
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_OPEC_is_founder = yes }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nfound = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_gv = 1 } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nf = 1 }
			add_to_temp_array = { cwop_t_bound = THIS }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_fshare = mdcw_cw_oil_export_share }
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_OPEC_is_founder = yes }
				add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_ffound = 1 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_gv = 2 } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_na = 1 }
			add_to_temp_array = { cwop_t_blockers = THIS }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_gv = 3 } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nr = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			# an absent player does not object: bound like a For vote (Art. 11), except on the OAPEC way and for admissions
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_nabs = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_route = 1 } }
					NOT = { check_variable = { cwop_t_thr = 2 } } }
				add_to_temp_array = { cwop_t_bound = THIS }
				add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_fshare = mdcw_cw_oil_export_share }
			}
		}
	}
	# the result
	if = {
		limit = { # OAPEC: a majority of the Arab oil ministers; who votes against is not bound
			check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_route = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_x = cwop_t_n }
		divide_temp_variable = { cwop_t_x = 2 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_nf > cwop_t_x } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_res = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_res = 4 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { # admission: three quarters of the full members including every founder (Art. 7)
			check_variable = { cwop_t_thr = 2 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_x = cwop_t_n }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_x = 0.75 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwop_t_nf < cwop_t_x } }
				check_variable = { cwop_t_ffound = cwop_t_nfound } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_res = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_res = 4 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { # procedural: simple majority of the votes cast
			check_variable = { cwop_t_thr = 3 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_nf > cwop_t_na } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_res = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_res = 4 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { # lifting: the For-voters lift their embargo
			check_variable = { cwop_t_thr = 4 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_nf > 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_res = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_res = 4 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		# Art. 11 C: unanimity - one Against blocks; a Reservation lets the resolution pass but does not bind
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_na > 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_res = 2 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_share = 1 }
				check_variable = { cwop_t_fshare < 0.15 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_res = 3 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_bound^num < 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_res = 4 }
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_res = 1 }
		}
	}
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwop_t_fshare min = 0 max = 1 }
}

# Any scope. Approval of an extraordinary Conference: a simple majority of the full members (Art. 12); an AI delegation approves unless it is Against the file.
COLDWAR_OPEC_tally_approval = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_yes = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_no = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwop_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_n = 1 }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_vote_of = yes
			if = {
				limit = { is_ai = yes }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_gv = 2 } }
					add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_no = 1 }
				}
				else = {
					add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_yes = 1 }
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_gv = 1 } }
					add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_yes = 1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_gv = 2 } }
					add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_no = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_x = cwop_t_n }
	divide_temp_variable = { cwop_t_x = 2 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_yes > cwop_t_x } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_ok = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_ok = 0 }
	}
}

# Country scope (player). temp cwop_t_slot, cwop_t_v (1 For / approve, 2 Against / reject, 3 Reservation). A vote can be changed until the vote closes.
COLDWAR_OPEC_cast_vote = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 1 } }
		set_variable = { cwop_v1 = cwop_t_v }
		set_variable = { cwop_vi1 = global.cwop_s1_issue }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 2 } }
		set_variable = { cwop_v2 = cwop_t_v }
		set_variable = { cwop_vi2 = global.cwop_s2_issue }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 3 } }
		set_variable = { cwop_v3 = cwop_t_v }
		set_variable = { cwop_vi3 = global.cwop_s3_issue }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 4 } }
		set_variable = { cwop_v4 = cwop_t_v }
		set_variable = { cwop_vi4 = global.cwop_s4_issue }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 5 } }
		set_variable = { cwop_v5 = cwop_t_v }
		set_variable = { cwop_vi5 = global.cwop_s5_issue }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 6 } }
		set_variable = { cwop_v6 = cwop_t_v }
		set_variable = { cwop_vi6 = global.cwop_s6_issue }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 7 } }
		set_variable = { cwop_v7 = cwop_t_v }
		set_variable = { cwop_vi7 = global.cwop_s7_issue }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 8 } }
		set_variable = { cwop_v8 = cwop_t_v }
		set_variable = { cwop_vi8 = global.cwop_s8_issue }
	}
	COLDWAR_OPEC_check_all_voted = yes
	add_to_variable = { global.cwop_dirty = 1 }
}

# Any scope. temp cwop_t_load: workload of the Secretariat, +15 % per open file beyond three (at most +60 %).
COLDWAR_OPEC_workload = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_act = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s1_phase > 0 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_act = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s2_phase > 0 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_act = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s3_phase > 0 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_act = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s4_phase > 0 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_act = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s5_phase > 0 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_act = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s6_phase > 0 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_act = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s7_phase > 0 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_act = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s8_phase > 0 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_act = 1 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_load = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_act > 3 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_x = cwop_t_act }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_x = -3 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_x = 0.15 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_load = cwop_t_x }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwop_t_load max = 1.6 }
	}
}

# Any scope. temp cwop_t_slot: first free file (0 = the Secretariat is full).
COLDWAR_OPEC_find_slot = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s1_phase = 0 }
			check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s2_phase = 0 }
			check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s3_phase = 0 }
			check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s4_phase = 0 }
			check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s5_phase = 0 }
			check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s6_phase = 0 }
			check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s7_phase = 0 }
			check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 7 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s8_phase = 0 }
			check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 8 }
	}
}

# Country scope (player). Opens a file for the temp request (cwop_t_item, target, opt1, opt2, route, invite, cost); the Secretary General pays half.
COLDWAR_OPEC_request = {
	COLDWAR_OPEC_find_slot = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_slot > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_pay = cwop_t_cost }
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_OPEC_is_sg = yes }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_pay = 0.5 }
		}
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_pay = -1 }
		add_political_power = cwop_t_pay
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 1 } }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_s1_open = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 2 } }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_s2_open = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 3 } }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_s3_open = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 4 } }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_open = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 5 } }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_open = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 6 } }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_s6_open = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 7 } }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_s7_open = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 8 } }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_s8_open = yes
		}
	}
	set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_player_seen days = 365 value = 1 }
}

# Country scope (Secretary General). temp cwop_t_slot: declines to table a requested draft.
COLDWAR_OPEC_decline_draft = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 1 }
			check_variable = { global.cwop_s1_phase = 1 }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_is_sg = yes }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s1_ctx = yes
		set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_res = 7 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:global.cwop_s1_by = { exists = yes is_ai = no } }
			var:global.cwop_s1_by = { set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eitem = global.cwop_ctx_item }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q2_item = cwop_t_eitem }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eres = 7 }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q2_res = cwop_t_eres }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_etarget = global.cwop_ctx_target }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q2_target = cwop_t_etarget }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eval = 0 }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q2_val = cwop_t_eval }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev2_busy } }
					set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev2_busy days = 30 value = 1 }
					country_event = { id = COLDWAR_OPEC.2 }
			} }
		}
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s1_free = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 2 }
			check_variable = { global.cwop_s2_phase = 1 }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_is_sg = yes }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s2_ctx = yes
		set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_res = 7 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:global.cwop_s2_by = { exists = yes is_ai = no } }
			var:global.cwop_s2_by = { set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eitem = global.cwop_ctx_item }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q2_item = cwop_t_eitem }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eres = 7 }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q2_res = cwop_t_eres }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_etarget = global.cwop_ctx_target }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q2_target = cwop_t_etarget }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eval = 0 }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q2_val = cwop_t_eval }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev2_busy } }
					set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev2_busy days = 30 value = 1 }
					country_event = { id = COLDWAR_OPEC.2 }
			} }
		}
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s2_free = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 3 }
			check_variable = { global.cwop_s3_phase = 1 }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_is_sg = yes }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s3_ctx = yes
		set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_res = 7 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:global.cwop_s3_by = { exists = yes is_ai = no } }
			var:global.cwop_s3_by = { set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eitem = global.cwop_ctx_item }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q2_item = cwop_t_eitem }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eres = 7 }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q2_res = cwop_t_eres }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_etarget = global.cwop_ctx_target }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q2_target = cwop_t_etarget }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eval = 0 }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q2_val = cwop_t_eval }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev2_busy } }
					set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev2_busy days = 30 value = 1 }
					country_event = { id = COLDWAR_OPEC.2 }
			} }
		}
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s3_free = yes
	}
	if = {

			check_variable = { global.cwop_s4_phase = 1 }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_is_sg = yes }

# Country scope (Secretary General). temp cwop_t_slot: tables a draft at once.
COLDWAR_OPEC_table_now = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 1 }
			check_variable = { global.cwop_s1_phase = 1 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s1_to_queue = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 2 }
			check_variable = { global.cwop_s2_phase = 1 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s2_to_queue = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 3 }
			check_variable = { global.cwop_s3_phase = 1 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s3_to_queue = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 4 }
			check_variable = { global.cwop_s4_phase = 1 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_to_queue = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 5 }
			check_variable = { global.cwop_s5_phase = 1 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_to_queue = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 6 }
			check_variable = { global.cwop_s6_phase = 1 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s6_to_queue = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 7 }
			check_variable = { global.cwop_s7_phase = 1 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s7_to_queue = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 8 }
			check_variable = { global.cwop_s8_phase = 1 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s8_to_queue = yes
	}
	add_to_variable = { global.cwop_dirty = 1 }
}

# Any scope. Weekly: while the Secretariat (the Secretary General, or the President ad interim) is governed by the AI, every requested draft is tabled at once, so the players can always vote (23.11.2026).
COLDWAR_OPEC_ai_office_tables = {
	if = {
		limit = { any_of_scopes = { array = global.cwop_members is_ai = yes COLDWAR_OPEC_is_sg = yes } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s1_phase = 1 } }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_s1_to_queue = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s2_phase = 1 } }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_s2_to_queue = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s3_phase = 1 } }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_s3_to_queue = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s4_phase = 1 } }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_to_queue = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s5_phase = 1 } }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_to_queue = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s6_phase = 1 } }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_s6_to_queue = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s7_phase = 1 } }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_s7_to_queue = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s8_phase = 1 } }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_s8_to_queue = yes
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. temp cwop_t_slot: the President puts a file first on the agenda (once per Conference).
COLDWAR_OPEC_bring_forward = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 1 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_s1_ticket = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 2 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_s2_ticket = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 3 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_s3_ticket = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 4 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_s4_ticket = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 5 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_s5_ticket = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 6 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_s6_ticket = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 7 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_s7_ticket = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 8 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_s8_ticket = 0 }
	}
	set_global_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_pres_forward_used
	add_to_variable = { global.cwop_dirty = 1 }
}

# Country scope (player member). temp cwop_t_slot: asks for an extraordinary Conference on a waiting file (100 PP).
COLDWAR_OPEC_ask_extra = {
	add_political_power = -100
	# the member who asks approves its own request
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 1 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s1_ask_extra = yes
		set_variable = { cwop_v1 = 1 }
		set_variable = { cwop_vi1 = global.cwop_s1_issue }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 2 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s2_ask_extra = yes
		set_variable = { cwop_v2 = 1 }
		set_variable = { cwop_vi2 = global.cwop_s2_issue }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 3 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s3_ask_extra = yes
		set_variable = { cwop_v3 = 1 }
		set_variable = { cwop_vi3 = global.cwop_s3_issue }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 4 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_ask_extra = yes
		set_variable = { cwop_v4 = 1 }
		set_variable = { cwop_vi4 = global.cwop_s4_issue }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 5 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_ask_extra = yes
		set_variable = { cwop_v5 = 1 }
		set_variable = { cwop_vi5 = global.cwop_s5_issue }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 6 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s6_ask_extra = yes
		set_variable = { cwop_v6 = 1 }
		set_variable = { cwop_vi6 = global.cwop_s6_issue }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 7 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s7_ask_extra = yes
		set_variable = { cwop_v7 = 1 }
		set_variable = { cwop_vi7 = global.cwop_s7_issue }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 8 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s8_ask_extra = yes
		set_variable = { cwop_v8 = 1 }
		set_variable = { cwop_vi8 = global.cwop_s8_issue }
	}
	add_to_variable = { global.cwop_dirty = 1 }
}

# Country scope (full member). temp cwop_t_slot: objects to an adopted file (Art. 11).
COLDWAR_OPEC_object = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 1 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s1_object = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 2 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s2_object = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 3 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s3_object = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 4 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_object = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 5 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_object = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 6 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s6_object = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 7 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s7_object = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 8 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_s8_object = yes
	}
}

# Country scope (player, the target). temp cwop_t_slot, cwop_t_v: 1 accepts, 2 declines the invitation or offer.
COLDWAR_OPEC_answer_offer = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 1 }
			check_variable = { global.cwop_s1_phase = 6 }
			check_variable = { global.cwop_s1_target = THIS.id } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_v = 1 } }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_s1_offer_accepted = yes
		}
		else = {
			COLDWAR_OPEC_s1_offer_declined = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 2 }
			check_variable = { global.cwop_s2_phase = 6 }
			check_variable = { global.cwop_s2_target = THIS.id } }

			COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_offer_accepted = yes

		else = {
			COLDWAR_OPEC_s4_offer_declined = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 5 }
			check_variable = { global.cwop_s5_phase = 6 }
			check_variable = { global.cwop_s5_target = THIS.id } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_v = 1 } }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_offer_accepted = yes
		}
		else = {
			COLDWAR_OPEC_s5_offer_declined = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 6 }
			check_variable = { global.cwop_s6_phase = 6 }
			check_variable = { global.cwop_s6_target = THIS.id } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_v = 1 } }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_s6_offer_accepted = yes
		}
		else = {
			COLDWAR_OPEC_s6_offer_declined = yes
		}

	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 7 }
			check_variable = { global.cwop_s7_phase = 6 }
			check_variable = { global.cwop_s7_target = THIS.id } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_v = 1 } }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_s7_offer_accepted = yes
		}
		else = {
			COLDWAR_OPEC_s7_offer_declined = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_slot = 8 }
			check_variable = { global.cwop_s8_phase = 6 }
			check_variable = { global.cwop_s8_target = THIS.id } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_v = 1 } }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_s8_offer_accepted = yes
		}
		else = {
			COLDWAR_OPEC_s8_offer_declined = yes
		}
	}
	add_to_variable = { global.cwop_dirty = 1 }
}

# Country scope (an AI delegation). Stance on the file in the context: interest from temperament and situation, persuasion by players; writes cwop_h (stance), cwop_ai (1 For, 2 Against, 3 Reservation) and the parts cwop_ic_* for the window.
COLDWAR_OPEC_stance = {
	set_variable = { cwop_ic_temp = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ic_money = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ic_price = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ic_bloc = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ic_war = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ic_opin = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ic_tgt = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ic_quota = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_tp = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_dir = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 11 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_tp = cwop_tp_sov }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_dir = 0 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 12 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_tp = cwop_tp_up }

		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_dir = 1 }

	else_if = {

		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_dir = 0 }
	}
	else_if = {

		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_tp = 5 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_dir = 0 }
	}
	else_if = {

		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_tp = cwop_tp_fund }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_dir = 0 }
	}
	else_if = {

		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_tp = cwop_tp_emb }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_dir = 0 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 52 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_tp = cwop_tp_emb }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_dir = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 53 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_tp = 5 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_dir = 0 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 54 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_tp = cwop_tp_emb }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_dir = 0 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 55 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_tp = cwop_tp_emb }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_dir = 0 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 56 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_tp = cwop_tp_emb }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_tp = -1 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_dir = -1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 57 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_tp = cwop_tp_emb }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_tp = -1 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_dir = 0 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 58 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_tp = cwop_tp_emb }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_tp = -1 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_dir = 0 }
	}
	# temperament (design 5.3)
	set_variable = { cwop_ic_temp = cwop_t_tp }
	# money: debt above 40 % of GDP or an empty treasury wants a higher price
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_OPEC_needs_money = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_dir = 1 } }
			set_variable = { cwop_ic_money = 15 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_dir = -1 } }
			set_variable = { cwop_ic_money = -15 }
		}
	}
	# price level: above 4x 1970 the big producers fear for demand; below 1.5x the posted price has lost purchasing power
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_dir = 1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_oil_ratio > 4 } }
			set_variable = { cwop_ic_price = -15 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_oil_ratio < 1.5 } }
			set_variable = { cwop_ic_price = 10 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_dir = -1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_oil_ratio > 4 } }
			set_variable = { cwop_ic_price = 15 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_oil_ratio < 1.5 } }
			set_variable = { cwop_ic_price = -10 }
		}
	}
	# bloc: a Western delegation does not embargo its own bloc; Eastern delegations like it
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 51 } check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 52 } check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 54 } check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 55 } check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 56 } check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 57 } check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 58 } check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 53 } }
			check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_target > 0 }
			var:global.cwop_ctx_target = { COLDWAR_OPEC_is_west = yes } }
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_OPEC_is_west = yes }
			set_variable = { cwop_ic_bloc = -40 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_OPEC_is_east = yes }
			set_variable = { cwop_ic_bloc = 15 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 56 } check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 57 } check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 58 } } }
			multiply_variable = { cwop_ic_bloc = -1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_dir = 1 }
			NOT = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 51 } check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 52 } check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 54 } check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 55 } } } }
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_OPEC_is_west = yes }
			set_variable = { cwop_ic_bloc = -5 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_OPEC_is_east = yes }
			set_variable = { cwop_ic_bloc = 5 }
		}
	}
	# an Arab-Israeli war in the last year: Arab delegations want the oil weapon (October 1973)
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_OPEC_is_arab = yes
			has_global_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_arab_war }
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 51 } check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 52 } check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 54 } check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 55 } } }
			set_variable = { cwop_ic_war = 30 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 56 } check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 57 } check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 58 } } }
			set_variable = { cwop_ic_war = -30 }
		}
	}
	# opinion of the requester
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_o = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_by > 0 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_by = THIS.id } }
			var:global.cwop_ctx_by = { exists = yes } }
		var:global.cwop_ctx_by = {
			PREV = {
				if = {
					limit = { has_opinion = { target = PREV value > 50 } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_o = 15 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { has_opinion = { target = PREV value > 20 } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_o = 8 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { has_opinion = { target = PREV value < -50 } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_o = -15 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { has_opinion = { target = PREV value < -20 } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_o = -8 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	set_variable = { cwop_ic_opin = cwop_t_o }
	# the target
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_tal = -1 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_tsh = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_target > 0 }
			var:global.cwop_ctx_target = { exists = yes } }
		var:global.cwop_ctx_target = { set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_tal = mdcw_cw_alignment } set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_tsh = mdcw_cw_oil_export_share } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_target > 0 }
			var:global.cwop_ctx_target = { exists = yes } }
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 51 } check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 52 } check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 54 } check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 55 } check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 56 } check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 57 } check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 58 } } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_o = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_target > 0 }
					NOT = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_target = THIS.id } }
					var:global.cwop_ctx_target = { exists = yes } }
				var:global.cwop_ctx_target = {
					PREV = {
						if = {
							limit = { has_opinion = { target = PREV value > 50 } }
							set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_o = -15 }
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { has_opinion = { target = PREV value > 20 } }
							set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_o = -8 }
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { has_opinion = { target = PREV value < -50 } }
							set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_o = 15 }
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { has_opinion = { target = PREV value < -20 } }
							set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_o = 8 }
						}
					}
				}
			}
			set_variable = { cwop_ic_tgt = cwop_t_o }
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_OPEC_is_arab = yes
					var:global.cwop_ctx_target = { OR = { original_tag = USA original_tag = HOL is_in_faction_with = ISR } } }
				add_to_variable = { cwop_ic_tgt = 20 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { COLDWAR_OPEC_is_arab = yes is_in_africa = yes }
					var:global.cwop_ctx_target = { OR = { original_tag = POR original_tag = SAF original_tag = ZIM } } }
				add_to_variable = { cwop_ic_tgt = 20 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:global.cwop_ctx_target = { OR = { COLDWAR_OPEC_is_member = yes COLDWAR_OPEC_is_oapec = yes } } }
				add_to_variable = { cwop_ic_tgt = -40 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:global.cwop_ctx_target = { mdcw_cw_is_bloc_leader = yes }
					check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment > 0 }
					check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = cwop_t_tal } }
				add_to_variable = { cwop_ic_tgt = -30 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 56 } check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 57 } check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 58 } } }
				multiply_variable = { cwop_ic_tgt = -1 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 53 } } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_o = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_target > 0 }
					NOT = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_target = THIS.id } }
					var:global.cwop_ctx_target = { exists = yes } }
				var:global.cwop_ctx_target = {
					PREV = {
						if = {
							limit = { has_opinion = { target = PREV value > 50 } }
							set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_o = 15 }
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { has_opinion = { target = PREV value > 20 } }
							set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_o = 8 }
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { has_opinion = { target = PREV value < -50 } }
							set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_o = -15 }
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { has_opinion = { target = PREV value < -20 } }
							set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_o = -8 }
						}
					}
				}
			}
			set_variable = { cwop_ic_tgt = cwop_t_o }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_opt1 = 4 } }
				multiply_variable = { cwop_ic_tgt = -1 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 41 } check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 42 } check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 47 } check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 49 } check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 50 } check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 32 } } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_o = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_target > 0 }
					NOT = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_target = THIS.id } }
					var:global.cwop_ctx_target = { exists = yes } }
				var:global.cwop_ctx_target = {
					PREV = {
						if = {
							limit = { has_opinion = { target = PREV value > 50 } }
							set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_o = 15 }
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { has_opinion = { target = PREV value > 20 } }
							set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_o = 8 }
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { has_opinion = { target = PREV value < -50 } }
							set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_o = -15 }
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { has_opinion = { target = PREV value < -20 } }
							set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_o = -8 }
						}
					}
				}
			}
			set_variable = { cwop_ic_tgt = cwop_t_o }
			if = {
				limit = { has_war_with = var:global.cwop_ctx_target }
				set_variable = { cwop_ic_tgt = -60 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment > 0 }
					check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = cwop_t_tal } }
				add_to_variable = { cwop_ic_tgt = 10 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 41 } }
					check_variable = { cwop_t_tsh > 0.05 } }
				add_to_variable = { cwop_ic_tgt = -10 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:global.cwop_ctx_target = { COLDWAR_OPEC_is_developing = yes } }
				add_to_variable = { cwop_ic_tgt = 10 }
			}
		}
	}
	# quotas: the big exporters guard their market share (Saudi Arabia)
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 22 } }
			check_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_export_share > 0.2 } }
		set_variable = { cwop_ic_quota = -10 }
	}
	COLDWAR_OPEC_stance_sum = yes
}

# Country scope. Interest (at most +-60) + persuasion of this file (at most +-50) = stance; the vote from the stance.
COLDWAR_OPEC_stance_sum = {
	set_variable = { cwop_int = 0 }
	add_to_variable = { cwop_int = cwop_ic_temp }
	add_to_variable = { cwop_int = cwop_ic_money }
	add_to_variable = { cwop_int = cwop_ic_price }
	add_to_variable = { cwop_int = cwop_ic_bloc }
	add_to_variable = { cwop_int = cwop_ic_war }
	add_to_variable = { cwop_int = cwop_ic_opin }
	add_to_variable = { cwop_int = cwop_ic_tgt }
	add_to_variable = { cwop_int = cwop_ic_quota }
	clamp_variable = { var = cwop_int min = -60 max = 60 }
	set_variable = { cwop_per = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_slot = 1 } }
		set_variable = { cwop_per = cwop_pl1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_slot = 2 } }
		set_variable = { cwop_per = cwop_pl2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_slot = 3 } }
		set_variable = { cwop_per = cwop_pl3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_slot = 4 } }
		set_variable = { cwop_per = cwop_pl4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_slot = 5 } }
		set_variable = { cwop_per = cwop_pl5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_slot = 6 } }
		set_variable = { cwop_per = cwop_pl6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_slot = 7 } }
		set_variable = { cwop_per = cwop_pl7 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_slot = 8 } }
		set_variable = { cwop_per = cwop_pl8 }
	}
	clamp_variable = { var = cwop_per min = -50 max = 50 }
	set_variable = { cwop_h = cwop_int }
	add_to_variable = { cwop_h = cwop_per }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwop_h < 25 } } }
		set_variable = { cwop_ai = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwop_h > -25 } } }
		set_variable = { cwop_ai = 2 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { cwop_ai = 3 }
	}
}

# Country scope (an AI country that received an invitation or offer). Accepts when its stance reaches +25 after the 30 days of lobbying.
COLDWAR_OPEC_offer_stance = {
	set_variable = { cwop_ic_temp = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ic_money = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ic_price = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ic_bloc = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ic_war = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ic_opin = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ic_tgt = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ic_quota = 0 }
	# what the offer means for this country
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 45 } } }
		set_variable = { cwop_ic_temp = 30 }
		# the United States want the dialogue (Kissinger 1975)
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 50 } } }
		set_variable = { cwop_ic_temp = 40 }
		# a Fund programme is welcome
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 47 } } }
		set_variable = { cwop_ic_temp = 20 }
		# observer status costs nothing (Egypt, Mexico, Norway, Oman sent observers)
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_OPEC_net_exporter = yes }
			set_variable = { cwop_ic_temp = 15 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_OPEC_is_developing = yes }
			add_to_variable = { cwop_ic_temp = 15 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 49 } }
				check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_oil_ratio < 1.5 } }
			add_to_variable = { cwop_ic_temp = 15 }
			# a falling price makes outsiders co-operate (Mexico 1986, Norway 1987)
		}
	}
	# bloc: non-aligned producers join easily, the blocs keep their producers apart
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 45 } check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 50 } } } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 0 } }
			set_variable = { cwop_ic_bloc = 15 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_OPEC_is_west = yes }
			set_variable = { cwop_ic_bloc = -25 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 2 } }
			set_variable = { cwop_ic_bloc = -40 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 3 } }
			set_variable = { cwop_ic_bloc = -20 }
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_o = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_by > 0 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_by = THIS.id } }
			var:global.cwop_ctx_by = { exists = yes } }
		var:global.cwop_ctx_by = {
			PREV = {
				if = {
					limit = { has_opinion = { target = PREV value > 50 } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_o = 15 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { has_opinion = { target = PREV value > 20 } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_o = 8 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { has_opinion = { target = PREV value < -50 } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_o = -15 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { has_opinion = { target = PREV value < -20 } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_o = -8 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	set_variable = { cwop_ic_opin = cwop_t_o }
	if = {
		limit = { any_of_scopes = { array = global.cwop_members has_war_with = PREV } }
		set_variable = { cwop_ic_war = -60 }
	}
	COLDWAR_OPEC_stance_sum = yes
}

# Country scope (AI delegation). temp cwop_t_k: candidate 1-4; temp cwop_t_sh: stance towards him (opinion, bloc, temperament, war, his lobbying).
COLDWAR_OPEC_sg_stance = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_sh = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_k = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_o = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_cand1 > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { global.cwop_cand1 = THIS.id } }
				var:global.cwop_cand1 = { exists = yes } }
			var:global.cwop_cand1 = {
				PREV = {
					if = {
						limit = { has_opinion = { target = PREV value > 50 } }
						set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_o = 15 }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { has_opinion = { target = PREV value > 20 } }
						set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_o = 8 }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { has_opinion = { target = PREV value < -50 } }
						set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_o = -15 }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { has_opinion = { target = PREV value < -20 } }
						set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_o = -8 }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_sh = cwop_t_o }
		if = {
			limit = { var:global.cwop_cand1 = { exists = yes } }
			var:global.cwop_cand1 = { set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_tal = mdcw_cw_alignment } set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_tk = cwop_kind } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment > 0 }
					check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = cwop_t_tal } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_sh = 10 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwop_kind = cwop_t_tk } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_sh = 10 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_war_with = var:global.cwop_cand1 }
				add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_sh = -60 }
			}
		}
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwop_t_sh min = -60 max = 60 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_p = cwop_sgp1 }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwop_t_p min = -50 max = 50 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_sh = cwop_t_p }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_k = 2 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_o = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_cand2 > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { global.cwop_cand2 = THIS.id } }
				var:global.cwop_cand2 = { exists = yes } }
			var:global.cwop_cand2 = {
				PREV = {
					if = {
						limit = { has_opinion = { target = PREV value > 50 } }
						set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_o = 15 }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { has_opinion = { target = PREV value > 20 } }
						set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_o = 8 }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { has_opinion = { target = PREV value < -50 } }
						set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_o = -15 }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { has_opinion = { target = PREV value < -20 } }
						set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_o = -8 }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_sh = cwop_t_o }
		if = {
			limit = { var:global.cwop_cand2 = { exists = yes } }
			var:global.cwop_cand2 = { set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_tal = mdcw_cw_alignment } set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_tk = cwop_kind } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment > 0 }
					check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = cwop_t_tal } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_sh = 10 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwop_kind = cwop_t_tk } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_sh = 10 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_war_with = var:global.cwop_cand2 }
				add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_sh = -60 }
			}
		}
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwop_t_sh min = -60 max = 60 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_p = cwop_sgp2 }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwop_t_p min = -50 max = 50 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_sh = cwop_t_p }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_k = 3 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_o = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_cand3 > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { global.cwop_cand3 = THIS.id } }
				var:global.cwop_cand3 = { exists = yes } }
			var:global.cwop_cand3 = {
				PREV = {
					if = {
						limit = { has_opinion = { target = PREV value > 50 } }
						set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_o = 15 }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { has_opinion = { target = PREV value > 20 } }
						set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_o = 8 }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { has_opinion = { target = PREV value < -50 } }
						set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_o = -15 }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { has_opinion = { target = PREV value < -20 } }
						set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_o = -8 }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_sh = cwop_t_o }
		if = {
			limit = { var:global.cwop_cand3 = { exists = yes } }
			var:global.cwop_cand3 = { set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_tal = mdcw_cw_alignment } set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_tk = cwop_kind } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment > 0 }
					check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = cwop_t_tal } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_sh = 10 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwop_kind = cwop_t_tk } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_sh = 10 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_war_with = var:global.cwop_cand3 }
				add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_sh = -60 }
			}
		}
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwop_t_sh min = -60 max = 60 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_p = cwop_sgp3 }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwop_t_p min = -50 max = 50 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_sh = cwop_t_p }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_k = 4 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_o = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_cand4 > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { global.cwop_cand4 = THIS.id } }
				var:global.cwop_cand4 = { exists = yes } }
			var:global.cwop_cand4 = {
				PREV = {
					if = {
						limit = { has_opinion = { target = PREV value > 50 } }
						set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_o = 15 }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { has_opinion = { target = PREV value > 20 } }
						set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_o = 8 }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { has_opinion = { target = PREV value < -50 } }
						set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_o = -15 }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { has_opinion = { target = PREV value < -20 } }
						set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_o = -8 }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_sh = cwop_t_o }
		if = {
			limit = { var:global.cwop_cand4 = { exists = yes } }
			var:global.cwop_cand4 = { set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_tal = mdcw_cw_alignment } set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_tk = cwop_kind } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment > 0 }
					check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = cwop_t_tal } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_sh = 10 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwop_kind = cwop_t_tk } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_sh = 10 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_war_with = var:global.cwop_cand4 }
				add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_sh = -60 }
			}
		}
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwop_t_sh min = -60 max = 60 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_p = cwop_sgp4 }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwop_t_p min = -50 max = 50 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_sh = cwop_t_p }
	}
}

# Country scope (AI quota holder). Quota discipline: temperament, money, temptation of a high price, market share, lobbying for or against the quota.
COLDWAR_OPEC_quota_stance = {
	set_variable = { cwop_ic_temp = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ic_money = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ic_price = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ic_bloc = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ic_war = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ic_opin = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ic_tgt = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ic_quota = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwop_ic_temp = cwop_tp_quota }
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_OPEC_needs_money = yes }
		set_variable = { cwop_ic_money = -15 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_oil_ratio > 2 } }
		set_variable = { cwop_ic_price = -10 }
		# a high price tempts to sell more
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_export_share > 0.2 } }
		set_variable = { cwop_ic_quota = -10 }
	}
	set_variable = { cwop_int = 0 }
	add_to_variable = { cwop_int = cwop_ic_temp }
	add_to_variable = { cwop_int = cwop_ic_money }
	add_to_variable = { cwop_int = cwop_ic_price }
	add_to_variable = { cwop_int = cwop_ic_bloc }
	add_to_variable = { cwop_int = cwop_ic_war }
	add_to_variable = { cwop_int = cwop_ic_opin }
	add_to_variable = { cwop_int = cwop_ic_tgt }
	add_to_variable = { cwop_int = cwop_ic_quota }
	clamp_variable = { var = cwop_int min = -60 max = 60 }
	set_variable = { cwop_per = cwop_pq }
	clamp_variable = { var = cwop_per min = -50 max = 50 }
	set_variable = { cwop_h = cwop_int }
	add_to_variable = { cwop_h = cwop_per }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwop_h > -25 } } }
		set_variable = { cwop_ai = 2 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { cwop_ai = 1 }
	}
}

# Any scope. Monthly while quotas run: AI quota holders whose discipline falls to -25 overproduce and leave the quota (London 1983-86).
COLDWAR_OPEC_quota_check = {
	clear_temp_array = cwop_t_over
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwop_quota
		if = { limit = { exists = yes is_ai = yes }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_quota_stance = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwop_ai = 2 } }
				add_to_temp_array = { cwop_t_over = THIS }
			}
		}
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = cwop_t_over
		remove_from_array = { global.cwop_quota = THIS }
		set_variable = { cwop_q_EX = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.cwop_overprod value = THIS } } }
			add_to_array = { global.cwop_overprod = THIS }
		}
		COLDWAR_OPEC_refresh_country = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_over^num > 0 } }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = cwop_t_over
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_ov = THIS.id }
			every_country = { limit = { is_ai = no COLDWAR_OPEC_is_member = yes } set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eitem = 22 }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q2_item = cwop_t_eitem }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eres = 10 }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q2_res = cwop_t_eres }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_etarget = cwop_t_ov }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q2_target = cwop_t_etarget }
				set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eval = 0 }
				add_to_array = { cwop_q2_val = cwop_t_eval }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev2_busy } }
					set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev2_busy days = 30 value = 1 }
					country_event = { id = COLDWAR_OPEC.2 }
			} }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope (player). Lobby (1), compensation (2) or bloc pressure (3) for (+1) or against (-1) a delegation on a file (0 = quota discipline, 9 = a candidate for Secretary General); once per kind, file and delegation. Every entry is public.
COLDWAR_OPEC_persuade = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_val = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_x_kind = 1 } }
		# lobby the delegation: 25 PP (half for an observer), 12 x trust (its opinion of us)
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_OPEC_is_observer = yes }
			add_political_power = -12
		}
		else = {
			add_political_power = -25
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_val = 12 }
		var:cwop_x_del = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_opinion = { target = ROOT value > 50 } }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_val = 1.5 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_opinion = { target = ROOT value > -20 } }

			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_opinion = { target = ROOT value > -50 } }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_val = 0.75 }
			}
			else = {
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_val = 0.5 }
			}
		}
		# a running Cold War programme to the delegation makes the lobby half again as strong
		if = {
			limit = { var:cwop_x_del = { PREV = { mdcw_cw_has_active_program_to_prev = yes } } }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_val = 1.5 }
		}
		round_temp_variable = cwop_t_val
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_x_kind = 2 } }
		# compensation: 0.2 % of our GDP to the delegation's treasury
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = gdp_total }
		multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.002 }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
		var:cwop_x_del = { modify_treasury_effect = yes add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = COLDWAR_OPEC_op_paid } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_val = 15 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_x_kind = 3 } }
		# bloc pressure of a bloc leader on a delegation of its own bloc
		add_political_power = -50
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_val = 25 }
		var:cwop_x_del = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = COLDWAR_OPEC_op_pressed } }
	}
	multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_val = cwop_x_dir }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_x_slot = 0 } }
		var:cwop_x_del = { add_to_variable = { cwop_pq = cwop_t_val } clamp_variable = { var = cwop_pq min = -50 max = 50 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_x_kind = 1 } }
			var:cwop_x_del = { add_to_array = { cwop_qlob = ROOT } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_x_kind = 2 } }
			var:cwop_x_del = { add_to_array = { cwop_qpay = ROOT } }
		}
		else = {
			var:cwop_x_del = { add_to_array = { cwop_qprs = ROOT } }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_x_slot = 9 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_x_cand = 1 } }
			var:cwop_x_del = { add_to_variable = { cwop_sgp1 = cwop_t_val } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_x_cand = 2 } }
			var:cwop_x_del = { add_to_variable = { cwop_sgp2 = cwop_t_val } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_x_cand = 3 } }
			var:cwop_x_del = { add_to_variable = { cwop_sgp3 = cwop_t_val } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_x_cand = 4 } }
			var:cwop_x_del = { add_to_variable = { cwop_sgp4 = cwop_t_val } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_x_kind = 1 } }
			var:cwop_x_del = { add_to_array = { cwop_lob9 = ROOT } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_x_kind = 2 } }
			var:cwop_x_del = { add_to_array = { cwop_pay9 = ROOT } }
		}
		else = {
			var:cwop_x_del = { add_to_array = { cwop_prs9 = ROOT } }
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_x_slot = 1 } }
			var:cwop_x_del = { add_to_variable = { cwop_pl1 = cwop_t_val } clamp_variable = { var = cwop_pl1 min = -50 max = 50 } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwop_x_kind = 1 } }
				var:cwop_x_del = { add_to_array = { cwop_lob1 = ROOT } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwop_x_kind = 2 } }
				var:cwop_x_del = { add_to_array = { cwop_pay1 = ROOT } }
			}
			else = {
				var:cwop_x_del = { add_to_array = { cwop_prs1 = ROOT } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_x_slot = 2 } }
			var:cwop_x_del = { add_to_variable = { cwop_pl2 = cwop_t_val } clamp_variable = { var = cwop_pl2 min = -50 max = 50 } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwop_x_kind = 1 } }
				var:cwop_x_del = { add_to_array = { cwop_lob2 = ROOT } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwop_x_kind = 2 } }
				var:cwop_x_del = { add_to_array = { cwop_pay2 = ROOT } }
			}
			else = {
				var:cwop_x_del = { add_to_array = { cwop_prs2 = ROOT } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_x_slot = 3 } }
			var:cwop_x_del = { add_to_variable = { cwop_pl3 = cwop_t_val } clamp_variable = { var = cwop_pl3 min = -50 max = 50 } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwop_x_kind = 1 } }
				var:cwop_x_del = { add_to_array = { cwop_lob3 = ROOT } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwop_x_kind = 2 } }
				var:cwop_x_del = { add_to_array = { cwop_pay3 = ROOT } }
			}
			else = {
				var:cwop_x_del = { add_to_array = { cwop_prs3 = ROOT } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_x_slot = 4 } }
			var:cwop_x_del = { add_to_variable = { cwop_pl4 = cwop_t_val } clamp_variable = { var = cwop_pl4 min = -50 max = 50 } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwop_x_kind = 1 } }
				var:cwop_x_del = { add_to_array = { cwop_lob4 = ROOT } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwop_x_kind = 2 } }
				var:cwop_x_del = { add_to_array = { cwop_pay4 = ROOT } }
			}
			else = {
				var:cwop_x_del = { add_to_array = { cwop_prs4 = ROOT } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_x_slot = 5 } }
			var:cwop_x_del = { add_to_variable = { cwop_pl5 = cwop_t_val } clamp_variable = { var = cwop_pl5 min = -50 max = 50 } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwop_x_kind = 1 } }
				var:cwop_x_del = { add_to_array = { cwop_lob5 = ROOT } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwop_x_kind = 2 } }
				var:cwop_x_del = { add_to_array = { cwop_pay5 = ROOT } }
			}
			else = {
				var:cwop_x_del = { add_to_array = { cwop_prs5 = ROOT } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_x_slot = 6 } }
			var:cwop_x_del = { add_to_variable = { cwop_pl6 = cwop_t_val } clamp_variable = { var = cwop_pl6 min = -50 max = 50 } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwop_x_kind = 1 } }
				var:cwop_x_del = { add_to_array = { cwop_lob6 = ROOT } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwop_x_kind = 2 } }
				var:cwop_x_del = { add_to_array = { cwop_pay6 = ROOT } }
			}
			else = {
				var:cwop_x_del = { add_to_array = { cwop_prs6 = ROOT } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_x_slot = 7 } }
			var:cwop_x_del = { add_to_variable = { cwop_pl7 = cwop_t_val } clamp_variable = { var = cwop_pl7 min = -50 max = 50 } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwop_x_kind = 1 } }
				var:cwop_x_del = { add_to_array = { cwop_lob7 = ROOT } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwop_x_kind = 2 } }
				var:cwop_x_del = { add_to_array = { cwop_pay7 = ROOT } }
			}
			else = {
				var:cwop_x_del = { add_to_array = { cwop_prs7 = ROOT } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_x_slot = 8 } }
			var:cwop_x_del = { add_to_variable = { cwop_pl8 = cwop_t_val } clamp_variable = { var = cwop_pl8 min = -50 max = 50 } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwop_x_kind = 1 } }
				var:cwop_x_del = { add_to_array = { cwop_lob8 = ROOT } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwop_x_kind = 2 } }
				var:cwop_x_del = { add_to_array = { cwop_pay8 = ROOT } }
			}
			else = {
				var:cwop_x_del = { add_to_array = { cwop_prs8 = ROOT } }
			}
		}
	}
	# the public ledger of the Conference (last six entries)
	set_variable = { global.cwop_led_who6 = global.cwop_led_who5 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_led_del6 = global.cwop_led_del5 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_led_val6 = global.cwop_led_val5 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_led_kind6 = global.cwop_led_kind5 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_led_who5 = global.cwop_led_who4 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_led_del5 = global.cwop_led_del4 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_led_val5 = global.cwop_led_val4 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_led_kind5 = global.cwop_led_kind4 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_led_who4 = global.cwop_led_who3 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_led_del4 = global.cwop_led_del3 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_led_val4 = global.cwop_led_val3 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_led_kind4 = global.cwop_led_kind3 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_led_who3 = global.cwop_led_who2 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_led_del3 = global.cwop_led_del2 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_led_val3 = global.cwop_led_val2 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_led_kind3 = global.cwop_led_kind2 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_led_who2 = global.cwop_led_who1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_led_del2 = global.cwop_led_del1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_led_val2 = global.cwop_led_val1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_led_kind2 = global.cwop_led_kind1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_led_who1 = ROOT.id }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_led_del1 = cwop_x_del }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_led_val1 = cwop_t_val }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_led_kind1 = cwop_x_kind }
	set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_player_seen days = 365 value = 1 }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwop_dirty = 1 }
}

# Country scope (player). Campaign for the candidate cwop_x_del: 25 PP, every AI delegation +12 x its trust in us towards him (once per election).
COLDWAR_OPEC_sg_campaign = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_k = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_cand1 = cwop_x_del } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_k = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_cand2 = cwop_x_del } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_k = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_cand3 = cwop_x_del } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_k = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_cand4 = cwop_x_del } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_k = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_k > 0 } }
		add_political_power = -25
		add_to_array = { global.cwop_sgcamp = THIS }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_cd = cwop_x_del }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwop_members
			if = {
				limit = { exists = yes }
				if = { limit = { is_ai = yes NOT = { check_variable = { cwop_t_cd = THIS.id } } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_val = 12 }
					if = {
						limit = { has_opinion = { target = PREV value > 50 } }
						multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_val = 1.5 }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { has_opinion = { target = PREV value > -20 } }

					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { has_opinion = { target = PREV value > -50 } }
						multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_val = 0.75 }
					}
					else = {
						multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_val = 0.5 }
					}
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_k = 1 } }
						add_to_variable = { cwop_sgp1 = cwop_t_val }
						clamp_variable = { var = cwop_sgp1 min = -50 max = 50 }
					}
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_k = 2 } }
						add_to_variable = { cwop_sgp2 = cwop_t_val }
						clamp_variable = { var = cwop_sgp2 min = -50 max = 50 }
					}
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_k = 3 } }
						add_to_variable = { cwop_sgp3 = cwop_t_val }
						clamp_variable = { var = cwop_sgp3 min = -50 max = 50 }
					}
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_k = 4 } }
						add_to_variable = { cwop_sgp4 = cwop_t_val }
						clamp_variable = { var = cwop_sgp4 min = -50 max = 50 }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { global.cwop_led_who6 = global.cwop_led_who5 }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_led_del6 = global.cwop_led_del5 }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_led_val6 = global.cwop_led_val5 }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_led_kind6 = global.cwop_led_kind5 }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_led_who5 = global.cwop_led_who4 }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_led_del5 = global.cwop_led_del4 }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_led_val5 = global.cwop_led_val4 }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_led_kind5 = global.cwop_led_kind4 }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_led_who4 = global.cwop_led_who3 }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_led_del4 = global.cwop_led_del3 }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_led_val4 = global.cwop_led_val3 }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_led_kind4 = global.cwop_led_kind3 }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_led_who3 = global.cwop_led_who2 }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_led_del3 = global.cwop_led_del2 }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_led_val3 = global.cwop_led_val2 }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_led_kind3 = global.cwop_led_kind2 }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_led_who2 = global.cwop_led_who1 }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_led_del2 = global.cwop_led_del1 }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_led_val2 = global.cwop_led_val1 }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_led_kind2 = global.cwop_led_kind1 }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_led_who1 = THIS.id }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_led_del1 = cwop_x_del }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_led_val1 = 12 }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_led_kind1 = 4 }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwop_dirty = 1 }
	}
}

# Any scope. temp <V>t_n_*: one world news for every player (queued: one news at a time, each with its own values).
COLDWAR_OPEC_news = {
	every_country = {
		limit = { is_ai = no }
		add_to_array = { cwop_nq_item = cwop_t_n_item }
		add_to_array = { cwop_nq_res = cwop_t_n_res }
		add_to_array = { cwop_nq_target = cwop_t_n_target }
		add_to_array = { cwop_nq_by = cwop_t_n_by }
		add_to_array = { cwop_nq_who = cwop_t_n_who }
		add_to_array = { cwop_nq_a = cwop_t_n_a }
		add_to_array = { cwop_nq_b = cwop_t_n_b }
		add_to_array = { cwop_nq_c = cwop_t_n_c }
		add_to_array = { cwop_nq_d = cwop_t_n_d }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_news_busy } }
			set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_news_busy days = 30 value = 1 }
			news_event = { id = COLDWAR_OPEC.30 }
		}
	}
}
